```ts
} from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-allocation';
import type { RefundMaterialLine, RefundMaterials } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-types';

// 割り振りの試験の値。Task 1 の DB 結合テストと同じ値で、TS と SQL の答えが食い違わないことを確かめる（本計画 P4）。
// 値 A: 注文の割引 1000 円を、商品の小計 6000 円（X）と 3000 円（Y）の割合で割った 667 円と 333 円
const X = { itemPrice: 3000, quantity: 2, lineDiscount: 667, refundedUnits: 0 } as const;
const Y = { itemPrice: 1000, quantity: 3, lineDiscount: 333, refundedUnits: 0 } as const;

function materialLine(overrides: Partial<RefundMaterialLine> = {}): RefundMaterialLine {
  return {
    orderItemId: 'item-x', name: 'シルクブラウス', color: '白', size: 'M', fulfillmentType: 'stock',
    itemPrice: 3000, quantity: 2, lineTotal: 6000, shipped: 0, unshipped: 2,
    refundedBeforeShipment: 0, refundedAfterShipment: 0, shippedRefundable: 0, restockable: 2,
    lineDiscount: 667, refundedUnits: 0, ...overrides,
  };
}

/** 値 A の X（在庫の品 3000 円 × 2） */
const LINE_X = materialLine();
/** 値 A の Y（受注生産の品 1000 円 × 3） */
const LINE_Y = materialLine({
  orderItemId: 'item-y', name: 'リネンパンツ', color: null, size: null, fulfillmentType: 'backorder',
  itemPrice: 1000, quantity: 3, lineTotal: 3000, unshipped: 3, restockable: 0, lineDiscount: 333,
});

function materials(overrides: { shippedTotal?: number; lines?: RefundMaterialLine[] } = {}): RefundMaterials {
  const lines = overrides.lines ?? [LINE_X, LINE_Y];
  return {
    order: {
      id: 'order-1', orderNumber: 'ORD-ORDER-1A', status: 'paid', paymentMethod: 'card',
      totalAmount: 8500, shippingAmount: 500, discountAmount: 1000, paidAmount: 8500,
      succeededAmount: 0, openAmount: 0, refundableAmount: 8500, refundedShipping: 0, refundableShipping: 500,
      shippedTotal: overrides.shippedTotal ?? 0,
      unshippedTotal: lines.reduce((total, line) => total + line.unshipped, 0),
    },
    lines,
    awaitingRefund: null,
  };
}

describe('unitsDiscount（disc(n) = floor((2·D·n + q) / (2·q))）', () => {
  it.each([
    ['値 A の X（D = 667、q = 2）', 667, 2, [[0, 0], [1, 334], [2, 667]]],
    ['値 A の Y（D = 333、q = 3）', 333, 3, [[0, 0], [1, 111], [2, 222], [3, 333]]],
    ['値 B: 割引が 0 なら、いつも 0', 0, 3, [[0, 0], [1, 0], [2, 0], [3, 0]]],
    ['値 C: 数 3・割引 1', 1, 3, [[0, 0], [1, 0], [2, 1], [3, 1]]],
  ] as const)('%s', (_name, lineDiscount, quantity, expected) => {
    for (const [units, discount] of expected) {
      expect(unitsDiscount(lineDiscount, quantity, units)).toBe(discount);
    }
  });

  it('まだ返していなければ disc(0) = 0、ぜんぶ返すと disc(q) = D になり、返す数が増えても減らない（端数が出ても合計がぴったり合う）', () => {
    for (let discount = 0; discount <= 12; discount += 1) {
      for (let quantity = 1; quantity <= 7; quantity += 1) {
        expect(unitsDiscount(discount, quantity, 0)).toBe(0);
        expect(unitsDiscount(discount, quantity, quantity)).toBe(discount);
        for (let units = 0; units < quantity; units += 1) {
          expect(unitsDiscount(discount, quantity, units + 1)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(unitsDiscount(discount, quantity, units));
        }
      }
    }
  });
});

describe('refundLineAmount（今回の k 個の額 = 単価 · k − (disc(b + k) − disc(b))）', () => {
  it.each([
    ['値 A: X をまだ返していない時に 1 個', X, 1, 2666],
    ['値 A: X を 1 個返した後に 1 個（最後の返金で合計がぴったり）', { ...X, refundedUnits: 1 }, 1, 2667],
    ['値 A: X を 2 個まとめて', X, 2, 5333],
    ['値 A: Y をまだ返していない時に 2 個', Y, 2, 1778],
    ['値 A: Y を 2 個返した後に 1 個', { ...Y, refundedUnits: 2 }, 1, 889],
    ['値 B: 割引が 0 なら 単価 × 数', { ...X, lineDiscount: 0 }, 2, 6000],
  ] as const)('%s → %i', (_name, line, units, expected) => {
    expect(refundLineAmount(line, units)).toBe(expected);
  });

  it('1個ずつ順に返しても合計は「単価 × 数 − 割引の合計」になり、まとめて返した額と同じ', () => {
    const lines = [X, Y, { ...X, lineDiscount: 0 }, { itemPrice: 1000, quantity: 3, lineDiscount: 1, refundedUnits: 0 }];

    for (const base of lines) {
      let oneByOne = 0;
      for (let refundedUnits = 0; refundedUnits < base.quantity; refundedUnits += 1) {
        oneByOne += refundLineAmount({ ...base, refundedUnits }, 1);
      }

      expect(oneByOne).toBe(base.itemPrice * base.quantity - base.lineDiscount);
      expect(refundLineAmount(base, base.quantity)).toBe(oneByOne);
    }
  });
});

describe('estimateRefund', () => {
  it('選んだ数が無ければ、商品も割引も 0。送料だけが合計に入る', () => {
    expect(estimateRefund([LINE_X, LINE_Y], [], 500)).toEqual({
      itemsAmount: 0, discountAmount: 0, shippingAmount: 500, total: 500,
    });
  });

  it('値 A: X を 1 個選ぶと、商品 3000・割引 334（正の数）・合計 2666', () => {
    expect(estimateRefund([LINE_X, LINE_Y], [{ orderItemId: 'item-x', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 1 }], 0)).toEqual({
      itemsAmount: 3000, discountAmount: 334, shippingAmount: 0, total: 2666,
    });
  });

  it('値 A: 前に 1 個返した X をもう 1 個選ぶと、割引は 333・合計は 2667', () => {
    const afterOne = materialLine({ refundedUnits: 1, refundedBeforeShipment: 1, unshipped: 1 });

    expect(estimateRefund([afterOne], [{ orderItemId: 'item-x', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 1 }], 0)).toEqual({
      itemsAmount: 3000, discountAmount: 333, shippingAmount: 0, total: 2667,
    });
  });

  it('値 A: 商品を2つ選び、送料を足す。X を 1 個・Y を 2 個・送料 500 → 商品 5000・割引 556・合計 4944', () => {
    const selections = [
      { orderItemId: 'item-x', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 1 },
      { orderItemId: 'item-y', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 2 },
    ];

    expect(estimateRefund([LINE_X, LINE_Y], selections, 500)).toEqual({
      itemsAmount: 5000, discountAmount: 556, shippingAmount: 500, total: 4944,
    });
  });

  it('値 A: 2回に分けて全部返すと、合計は 商品の合計 9000 − 割引 1000 = 8000 にぴったり合う', () => {
    const first = estimateRefund(
      [LINE_X, LINE_Y],
      [{ orderItemId: 'item-x', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 1 }, { orderItemId: 'item-y', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 2 }],
      0,
    );
    // 1回目で返した数（X は 1 個、Y は 2 個）を、材料の refundedUnits に入れて読み直した形
    const second = estimateRefund(
      [materialLine({ refundedUnits: 1, unshipped: 1 }), { ...LINE_Y, refundedUnits: 2, unshipped: 1 }],
      [{ orderItemId: 'item-x', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 1 }, { orderItemId: 'item-y', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 1 }],
      0,
    );

    expect(first.total).toBe(4444);
    expect(second.total).toBe(3556);
    expect(first.total + second.total).toBe(8000);
  });

  it('同じ返金に同じ商品の発送前と発送後の選びがあっても、合計は発送前 → 発送後に分けて数えた額の和と同じで、並べた順に依らない（行ごとの額の順は DB が確かめる）。値 A: 2666 + 2667', () => {
    const shippedOne = materialLine({ shipped: 1, unshipped: 1, shippedRefundable: 1 });
    const beforeShipment = { orderItemId: 'item-x', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 1 };
    const afterShipment = { orderItemId: 'item-x', beforeShipment: false, quantity: 1 };

    // 発送前の 1 個は b = 0 で 2666。続けて発送後の 1 個は b = 0 + 1 で 2667
    const first = estimateRefund([shippedOne], [beforeShipment], 0);
    const second = estimateRefund([{ ...shippedOne, refundedUnits: 1 }], [afterShipment], 0);
    expect(first.total).toBe(2666);
    expect(second.total).toBe(2667);

    // 同じ返金に2つとも入れると、商品の額 6000（割引の前）・割引 667（正の数）・合計 5333 = 2666 + 2667。選びを並べた順は関係しない
    const together = { itemsAmount: 6000, discountAmount: 667, shippingAmount: 0, total: 5333 };
    expect(estimateRefund([shippedOne], [beforeShipment, afterShipment], 0)).toEqual(together);
    expect(estimateRefund([shippedOne], [afterShipment, beforeShipment], 0)).toEqual(together);
    expect(first.total + second.total).toBe(together.total);
  });

  it('値 B: 割引が 0 の商品は、単価 × 数がそのまま合計になる', () => {
    const noDiscount = materialLine({ lineDiscount: 0 });

    expect(estimateRefund([noDiscount], [{ orderItemId: 'item-x', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 2 }], 500)).toEqual({
      itemsAmount: 6000, discountAmount: 0, shippingAmount: 500, total: 6500,
    });
  });

  it('数が1に満たない・整数でない・材料に無い商品の選びは数えない', () => {
    const selections = [
      { orderItemId: 'item-x', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 0 },
      { orderItemId: 'item-x', beforeShipment: true, quantity: -1 },
      { orderItemId: 'item-x', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 1.5 },
      { orderItemId: 'item-x', beforeShipment: true, quantity: Number.NaN },
      { orderItemId: 'item-unknown', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 2 },
    ];

    expect(estimateRefund([LINE_X, LINE_Y], selections, 0)).toEqual({
      itemsAmount: 0, discountAmount: 0, shippingAmount: 0, total: 0,
    });
  });
});

describe('selectsAllUnshipped（発送が0で、残りの未発送を全部、発送前として選んだか）', () => {
  const selectAll = [
    { orderItemId: 'item-x', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 2 },
    { orderItemId: 'item-y', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 3 },
  ];

  it('全部の商品の未発送を、発送前として選んでいれば true', () => {
    expect(selectsAllUnshipped(materials(), selectAll)).toBe(true);

  it('商品を1つ選んでいなければ false', () => {
    expect(selectsAllUnshipped(materials(), selectAll.slice(0, 1))).toBe(false);

  });

  it('1つの商品で、未発送より1個でも少なければ false', () => {
    const oneShort = [selectAll[0], { orderItemId: 'item-y', beforeShipment: true, quantity: 2 }];

    expect(selectsAllUnshipped(materials(), oneShort)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('発送後の商品として選んだ数は、未発送の全部には数えない', () => {
    const afterShipment = [selectAll[0], { orderItemId: 'item-y', beforeShipment: false, quantity: 3 }];

    expect(selectsAllUnshipped(materials(), afterShipment)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('1つでも発送している注文は、未発送を全部選んでも false（送料と返金額を全部に固定しない）', () => {

  it('未発送が残っていない商品には選びが要らない（前に全部返した商品があっても、残りを全部選べば true）', () => {
    const refundedBefore = materialLine({ orderItemId: 'item-done', unshipped: 0, refundedBeforeShipment: 1, refundedUnits: 1 });

    expect(selectsAllUnshipped(materials({ lines: [refundedBefore, LINE_X] }), [selectAll[0]])).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

```ts
import type { CancelReason, OrderStatus } from '@/lib/orders/order-payment-types';

/**
 * 返金の窓口の形と記号（グループ E-2 設計書 3〜5 章）。窓口・DB の呼び出し・画面が同じ型を使うので、
```

`src/lib/orders/refund/refund-allocation.ts`:

```ts
import type { RefundMaterialLine, RefundMaterials } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-types';

/**
 * 返金額の見込み（グループ E-2 設計書 4-5）。返金の画面が、選んだ数から額を先に見せるために使う。画面からも読む。
 * 記録する額は DB の関数 begin_order_refund が同じ式で出す（SQL が正）。商品ごとの割引の合計 Dᵢ は DB が材料に入れて返す
 * （lineDiscount）ので、ここでは割り振らない。TS と SQL は同じ試験の値（値 A・B・C）で確かめる。
 */

/** disc(n) = floor((2·D·n + q) / (2·q))。D は商品の割引の合計（材料の lineDiscount）、q は注文の数、n は返す数の合計 */
export function unitsDiscount(lineDiscount: number, quantity: number, units: number): number {
  return Math.floor((2 * lineDiscount * units + quantity) / (2 * quantity));
}

/** 前に返した数 refundedUnits の後に、units 個を返す時の額（単価 · units − (disc(b + units) − disc(b))） */
export function refundLineAmount(
  line: Pick<RefundMaterialLine, 'itemPrice' | 'quantity' | 'lineDiscount' | 'refundedUnits'>,
  units: number,
): number {
  const discount =
    unitsDiscount(line.lineDiscount, line.quantity, line.refundedUnits + units) -
    unitsDiscount(line.lineDiscount, line.quantity, line.refundedUnits);
  return line.itemPrice * units - discount;
}

export type RefundSelection = { orderItemId: string; beforeShipment: boolean; quantity: number };
export type RefundEstimate = { itemsAmount: number; discountAmount: number; shippingAmount: number; total: number };

/** 選んだ数と送料からの見込み。割引の分は正の数（画面は − を付けて出す） */
export function estimateRefund(
  lines: readonly RefundMaterialLine[],
  selections: readonly RefundSelection[],
  shippingAmount: number,
): RefundEstimate {
  // 同じ返金に同じ商品の発送前と発送後の選びがある時は、発送前を先に数える（発送前の b は前に返した数 refundedUnits、
  // 発送後の b は refundedUnits + 発送前の数。Global Constraints）。割引の差は足し合わせると同じ額になるので、数を足して1回で出す
  const unitsByItem = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const selection of selections) {
    if (Number.isInteger(selection.quantity) && selection.quantity >= 1) {
      unitsByItem.set(selection.orderItemId, (unitsByItem.get(selection.orderItemId) ?? 0) + selection.quantity);
    }
  }

  let itemsAmount = 0;
  let discountAmount = 0;
  for (const line of lines) {
    const units = unitsByItem.get(line.orderItemId);
    if (!units) {
      continue;
    }
    itemsAmount += line.itemPrice * units;
    discountAmount += line.itemPrice * units - refundLineAmount(line, units);
  }
  return { itemsAmount, discountAmount, shippingAmount, total: itemsAmount - discountAmount + shippingAmount };
}

/**
 * 発送が0で、残りの未発送を全部、発送前として選んだか。そうなら返金額は返せる額の全部、送料は min(返せる送料, 返せる額) に固定する
 * （送る物が無いのにキャンセルにならない注文を残さないため。DB の REFUND_MUST_BE_FULL と同じ条件）。
 * この関数は条件を答えるだけ。固定する額は、true の時に画面が材料の refundableAmount・refundableShipping から出す。
 */
export function selectsAllUnshipped(materials: RefundMaterials, selections: readonly RefundSelection[]): boolean {
  if (materials.order.shippedTotal !== 0) {
    return false;
  }
  const unshippedLines = materials.lines.filter((line) => line.unshipped > 0);
  return (
    unshippedLines.length > 0 &&
    unshippedLines.every((line) => {
      const selected = selections
        .filter((selection) => selection.orderItemId === line.orderItemId && selection.beforeShipment)
        .reduce((total, selection) => total + selection.quantity, 0);
      return selected === line.unshipped;
    })
  );
}
```

```ts
  ['exceeds_refundable', 409, '返せる額を超えています。'],
  ['must_include_unshipped', 409, '全額を返金する時は、まだ発送していない商品もすべて選んでください。'],
  ['must_be_full', 409, 'まだ発送していない注文の商品を全部返す時は、送料と返金額も全部返してください。'],
  ['invalid_argument', 400, '入力を確かめてください。'],
] as const;

describe('返金の記号', () => {
  it('返金の道・状態・Stripe に伝える理由は Global Constraints のとおり', () => {
    expect([...ORDER_REFUND_SOURCES]).toEqual([
      'admin', 'order_cancel', 'stripe_dashboard', 'auto_cancelled_order_payment', 'auto_amount_mismatch', 'legacy',
    ]);
    expect([...ORDER_REFUND_STATUSES]).toEqual(['awaiting_response', 'error', 'pending', 'succeeded', 'failed']);
    expect([...STRIPE_REFUND_REASONS]).toEqual(['requested_by_customer', 'duplicate', 'fraudulent']);
  });

  it('窓口が返す13の誤りの記号は共通の約束のとおり', () => {
    expect([...REFUND_ERROR_CODES]).toEqual([
      'order_not_found', 'order_not_refundable', 'order_not_cancellable', 'awaiting_refund_exists', 'refund_request_mismatch',
      'refund_line_not_in_order', 'quantity_exceeds_unshipped', 'quantity_exceeds_shipped', 'shipping_exceeds',
      'exceeds_refundable', 'must_include_unshipped', 'must_be_full', 'invalid_argument',
    ]);
  });
});

describe('誤りの記号ごとの HTTP と言葉', () => {
  it.each(EXPECTED)('%s は %i、言葉は「%s」', (code, status, message) => {
    expect(REFUND_ERROR_MESSAGES[code]).toEqual({ status, message });
    expect(refundErrorBody(code)).toEqual({ error: message, code });
  });

  it('表は誤りの記号を過不足なく持つ（記号を足したら言葉と HTTP も要る）', () => {
    const codes = [...REFUND_ERROR_CODES].sort();

    expect(EXPECTED.map(([code]) => code).sort()).toEqual(codes);
    expect(Object.keys(REFUND_ERROR_MESSAGES).sort()).toEqual(codes);
  });
});

describe('入力の誤り・失敗・Stripe の断り・答えが分からない時の言葉', () => {
  it('入力の誤りは 400 の窓口で、記号は invalid_request', () => {
    expect(INVALID_REQUEST_MESSAGE).toBe('入力を確かめてください。');
    expect(INVALID_REQUEST_BODY).toEqual({ error: '入力を確かめてください。', code: 'invalid_request' });
  });

  it('失敗（500）の言葉は窓口ごとに違い、記号は failed', () => {
    expect(REFUND_FAILURE_MESSAGES).toEqual({
      create: '返金の記録に失敗しました。',
      cancel: '注文のキャンセルに失敗しました。',
      materials: '返金の材料を読み込めませんでした。',
      settings: 'ショップの設定を読み込めませんでした。',
      settings_update: 'ショップの設定を保存できませんでした。',
    });
    expect(refundFailureBody('cancel')).toEqual({ error: '注文のキャンセルに失敗しました。', code: 'failed' });
    expect(refundFailureBody('settings_update')).toEqual({ error: 'ショップの設定を保存できませんでした。', code: 'failed' });
  });

  it('Stripe の断り（422）は、理由があれば括弧で添える。理由が無い・空なら添えない', () => {
    expect(stripeRejectedBody('カード会社に断られました')).toEqual({
      error: 'Stripe が返金を受け付けませんでした（カード会社に断られました）。',
      code: 'stripe_rejected',
    });
    expect(stripeRejectedBody(null)).toEqual({ error: 'Stripe が返金を受け付けませんでした。', code: 'stripe_rejected' });
    expect(stripeRejectedBody('')).toEqual({ error: 'Stripe が返金を受け付けませんでした。', code: 'stripe_rejected' });
  });

  it('答えが分からない時（502）の言葉は Global Constraints のとおり。返金の番号を添える', () => {
    expect(UNKNOWN_REFUND_OUTCOME_MESSAGE).toBe(
      '返金の結果を確かめられませんでした。「もう一度確かめる」を押すと、二重にならずに確かめ直します。',
    );
    expect(unknownOutcomeBody(REFUND_ID)).toEqual({
      error: UNKNOWN_REFUND_OUTCOME_MESSAGE,
      code: 'unknown_outcome',
      refundId: REFUND_ID,
    });
  });
});
```

`src/lib/orders/refund/refund-messages.ts`:

```ts
import type {
  OrderRefundSource,
  OrderRefundStatus,
  RefundErrorCode,
  RefundErrorResponse,
  RefundPaymentMethod,
  StripeRefundReason,
} from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-types';

/**
 * 返金の窓口の誤りの言葉と HTTP、履歴や画面に出す言葉（グループ E-2 設計書 5-5・9-2）。窓口と画面の両方が使うので、
 * サーバーだけの物を import しない。画面に出す言葉は、ここの1か所だけで持つ。
 */
export const REFUND_ERROR_MESSAGES = {
  order_not_found: { status: 404, message: '注文が見つかりません。' },
  order_not_refundable: { status: 409, message: 'この注文は返金できません。' },
  order_not_cancellable: { status: 409, message: '発送した商品がある注文はキャンセルできません。返金の画面を使ってください。' },
  awaiting_refund_exists: { status: 409, message: '確かめ中の返金があります。先に確かめてください。' },
  refund_request_mismatch: { status: 409, message: '画面を開き直してから、もう一度返金してください。' },
  refund_line_not_in_order: { status: 409, message: '返金できる数を超えています。画面を開き直してください。' },
  quantity_exceeds_unshipped: { status: 409, message: '返金できる数を超えています。画面を開き直してください。' },
  quantity_exceeds_shipped: { status: 409, message: '返金できる数を超えています。画面を開き直してください。' },
  shipping_exceeds: { status: 409, message: '返せる送料を超えています。' },
  exceeds_refundable: { status: 409, message: '返せる額を超えています。' },
  must_include_unshipped: { status: 409, message: '全額を返金する時は、まだ発送していない商品もすべて選んでください。' },
  must_be_full: { status: 409, message: 'まだ発送していない注文の商品を全部返す時は、送料と返金額も全部返してください。' },
  invalid_argument: { status: 400, message: '入力を確かめてください。' },
} as const satisfies Record<RefundErrorCode, { status: 400 | 404 | 409; message: string }>;

/** 窓口に届いた中身の形が誤っている時（400）。どこが誤りかは返さない */
export const INVALID_REQUEST_MESSAGE = '入力を確かめてください。';
export const INVALID_REQUEST_BODY: RefundErrorResponse = { error: INVALID_REQUEST_MESSAGE, code: 'invalid_request' };

/** 思いがけない失敗（500）の言葉。何をしようとして失敗したかで分ける */
export const REFUND_FAILURE_MESSAGES = {
  create: '返金の記録に失敗しました。',
  cancel: '注文のキャンセルに失敗しました。',
  materials: '返金の材料を読み込めませんでした。',
  settings: 'ショップの設定を読み込めませんでした。',
  settings_update: 'ショップの設定を保存できませんでした。',
} as const;
export type RefundFailureKind = keyof typeof REFUND_FAILURE_MESSAGES;

/** 通信が切れたなど、サーバーが返金を記録したか分からない時（502）に画面が出す言葉。返金とキャンセルの両方で使う */
export const UNKNOWN_REFUND_OUTCOME_MESSAGE =
  '返金の結果を確かめられませんでした。「もう一度確かめる」を押すと、二重にならずに確かめ直します。';

export function refundErrorBody(code: RefundErrorCode): RefundErrorResponse {
  return { error: REFUND_ERROR_MESSAGES[code].message, code };
}

export function refundFailureBody(kind: RefundFailureKind): RefundErrorResponse {
  return { error: REFUND_FAILURE_MESSAGES[kind], code: 'failed' };
}

/** Stripe が返金を断った時（422）。理由の言葉があれば括弧で添える */
export function stripeRejectedBody(reasonLabel: string | null): RefundErrorResponse {
  return {
    error: `Stripe が返金を受け付けませんでした${reasonLabel ? `（${reasonLabel}）` : ''}。`,
    code: 'stripe_rejected',
  };
}

/** 答えが分からない時（502）。画面は返金の番号を持ち、同じ二重防止の番号で送り直して確かめる */
export function unknownOutcomeBody(refundId: string): RefundErrorResponse {
  return { error: UNKNOWN_REFUND_OUTCOME_MESSAGE, code: 'unknown_outcome', refundId };
}

export const REFUND_STATUS_LABELS = {
  awaiting_response: '返事待ち',
  error: 'エラー',
  pending: '保留',
  succeeded: '成功',
  failed: '失敗',
} as const satisfies Record<OrderRefundStatus, string>;

/** 履歴の返金の行の「どこから」 */
export const REFUND_SOURCE_LABELS = {
  admin: '管理画面',
  order_cancel: '注文のキャンセル',
  stripe_dashboard: 'Stripe の画面',
  auto_cancelled_order_payment: '自動の返金（取り消した注文への入金）',
  auto_amount_mismatch: '自動の取消（支払額の違い）',
  legacy: '前からの写し',
} as const satisfies Record<OrderRefundSource, string>;

export const STRIPE_REFUND_REASON_LABELS = {
  requested_by_customer: 'お客様の希望',
  duplicate: '重複した支払い',
  fraudulent: '不正の疑い',
} as const satisfies Record<StripeRefundReason, string>;

/**
 * 返金の失敗の理由の言葉（Stripe の失敗の理由と、こちらの理由 not_found_in_stripe・stripe_rejected）。
 * Stripe は表に無い記号も返すので、呼ぶ側は Object.hasOwn(REFUND_FAILURE_REASON_LABELS, reason) ? REFUND_FAILURE_REASON_LABELS[reason] : REFUND_FAILURE_REASON_LABELS.unknown で引く。
 * ?? で引くと、constructor のような名前は Object.prototype の物が返り、表に無い記号が「不明な理由」にならない。
 */
export const REFUND_FAILURE_REASON_LABELS: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  expired_or_canceled_card: 'カードが使えません',
  lost_or_stolen_card: 'カードが使えません',
  declined: 'カード会社に断られました',
  insufficient_funds: 'Stripe の残高が足りません',
  merchant_request: '店が取り消しました',
  expired: '口座の入力の期限が過ぎました',
  charge_for_pending_refund_disputed: '異議申し立てがありました',
  not_found_in_stripe: 'Stripe に届きませんでした',
  stripe_rejected: 'Stripe が受け付けませんでした',
  unknown: '不明な理由',
};

const REFUND_TIMING_NOTES = {
  card: 'お金はカード会社によって、5〜10営業日ほどで戻ります。',
  link: 'お金はカード会社によって、5〜10営業日ほどで戻ります。',
  paypay: 'お金は PayPay 残高にすぐ戻ります。',
  konbini: 'コンビニ払いの返金は、お客様に返金先の口座を入れてもらう必要があります（Stripe からお客様にメールが届きます。45日以内）。',
  unknown: 'お金が戻るまでの日数は、お支払いの方法によって異なります。',
} as const satisfies Record<RefundPaymentMethod, string>;

/** 返金の画面に出す、お金が戻る時期の案内（支払い方法ごと） */
export function refundTimingNote(method: RefundPaymentMethod): string {
  return REFUND_TIMING_NOTES[method];
}

/**
 * 金額の書き方（本計画の Global Constraints「金額の書き方」）。ブラウザの画面で使う。
 * メールとサーバーの formatCurrency（src/lib/orders/order-confirmation-email.ts）と同じ出力で、全角の ￥ と桁区切りになる。
 */
export function formatYen(amount: number): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat('ja-JP', { style: 'currency', currency: 'JPY', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(amount);
}
```

```ts
import type { OrderStatus } from '@/lib/orders/order-payment-types';

/**
 * 管理画面の注文の一覧の「支払い」の列の言葉（グループ E-2 設計書 9-1）。一覧の窓口・CSV・画面が同じ言葉を出すので、
 * 画面からも読む。サーバーだけの物を import しない。
 * 「進み具合」（order-progress.ts）は発送の進み具合、こちらはお金の状態。
 */
export const PAYMENT_STATUS_KEYS = ['unpaid', 'failed', 'none', 'paid', 'partially_refunded', 'refunded'] as const;
export type PaymentStatusKey = (typeof PAYMENT_STATUS_KEYS)[number];

export const PAYMENT_STATUS_LABELS = {
  unpaid: '未入金',
  failed: '支払いの失敗',
  none: '支払いなし',
  paid: '支払い済み',
  partially_refunded: '一部返金',
  refunded: '返金済み',
} as const satisfies Record<PaymentStatusKey, string>;

/** 返事待ち・保留の返金がある注文に付ける小さな印 */
export const REFUND_PENDING_BADGE = '返金の手続き中';
/** 開いている「返金の失敗」の要対応がある注文に付ける小さな印 */
export const REFUND_FAILED_BADGE = '返金の失敗';

/**
 * 上から順に当てはめて、最初に当たった1つを返す。
 * 1. payment_in_progress・pending → unpaid
 * 2. failed → failed
 * 3. abandoned → none
 * 4. paidAmount が空か0 → none（未入金のまま取り消した注文を含む）
 * 5. refundedAmount が0 → paid
 * 6. refundedAmount < paidAmount → partially_refunded
 * 7. それ以外 → refunded
 * refundedAmount は成功した返金の合計（orders.refunded_amount）。
 */
export function derivePaymentStatus(input: {
  status: OrderStatus;
  paidAmount: number | null;
  refundedAmount: number;
}): PaymentStatusKey {
  if (input.status === 'payment_in_progress' || input.status === 'pending') {
    return 'unpaid';
  }
  if (input.status === 'failed') {
    return 'failed';
  }
  if (input.status === 'abandoned') {
    return 'none';
  }
  if (!input.paidAmount) {
    return 'none';
  }
  if (input.refundedAmount === 0) {
    return 'paid';
  }
  return input.refundedAmount < input.paidAmount ? 'partially_refunded' : 'refunded';
}
```

`src/lib/orders/order-progress.ts` — 次の部分を置き換える（62〜73行目。`deriveOrderProgress` の説明・引数・「キャンセルの手続き中」の判定）:

置き換える前:

```ts
/**
 * 注文の言葉。paid・shipped は、商品の段階のうちいちばん手前（受注生産中 → 発送準備中 → 配送中）にそろえる。
 * 配達済みは配送の状況を持つ E-4 から。E-1 では、発送した品は全部「配送中」になる。
 */
export function deriveOrderProgress(status: OrderStatus, lines: readonly OrderLineProgressCounts[]): OrderProgress {
  if (status !== 'paid' && status !== 'shipped') {
    const key = FIXED_PROGRESS_KEYS[status];
    return { key, label: ORDER_PROGRESS_LABELS[key], partiallyShipped: false };
  }

  const shipped = sumOf(lines, (line) => line.shipped);
  let key: OrderProgressKey = 'ready';
```

置き換えた後:

```ts
/**
 * 注文の言葉。paid・shipped は、商品の段階のうちいちばん手前（受注生産中 → 発送準備中 → 配送中）にそろえる。
 * 配達済みは配送の状況を持つ E-4 から。E-1 では、発送した品は全部「配送中」になる。
 * paid で、送った品も未発送の品も無く（発送前に全部返金した）、返金のお金がまだ戻っていない（hasOpenRefund）間は
 * 「キャンセルの手続き中」（E-2 設計書 5-3）。返金が成功すれば注文が cancelled になり、この言葉は「キャンセル」に変わる。
 */
export function deriveOrderProgress(
  status: OrderStatus,
  lines: readonly OrderLineProgressCounts[],
  options?: { hasOpenRefund?: boolean },
): OrderProgress {
  if (status !== 'paid' && status !== 'shipped') {
    const key = FIXED_PROGRESS_KEYS[status];
    return { key, label: ORDER_PROGRESS_LABELS[key], partiallyShipped: false };
  }

  const shipped = sumOf(lines, (line) => line.shipped);
  if (status === 'paid' && options?.hasOpenRefund && shipped === 0 && sumOf(lines, (line) => line.unshipped) === 0) {
    return { key: 'cancel_pending', label: ORDER_PROGRESS_LABELS.cancel_pending, partiallyShipped: false };
  }
  let key: OrderProgressKey = 'ready';
```

```ts
  type BeginRefundInput,
  type RefundStore,
  type StripeRefundFields,
} from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-store';
import { REFUND_ERROR_CODES, type RefundErrorCode } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-types';

const ORDER_ID = 'a1b2c3d4-1111-4222-8333-444455556666';
const OTHER_ORDER_ID = 'a1b2c3d4-1111-4222-8333-444455557777';
const EMPTY_ORDER_ID = 'a1b2c3d4-1111-4222-8333-444455558888';
const ACTOR_ID = 'b1b2c3d4-1111-4222-8333-444455556666';
const REQUEST_KEY = 'c1b2c3d4-1111-4222-8333-444455556666';
const REFUND_ID = 'd1b2c3d4-1111-4222-8333-444455556666';
const EXCEPTION_ID = 'e1b2c3d4-1111-4222-8333-444455556666';
const ITEM_1 = 'f1b2c3d4-1111-4222-8333-444455556661';
const ITEM_2 = 'f1b2c3d4-1111-4222-8333-444455556662';
const STRIPE_REFUND_ID = 're_3AbcXyz123';
const PAYMENT_INTENT_ID = 'pi_3Abc123';

type RpcAnswer = { data?: unknown; error?: { message?: string; code?: string } | null };

/** rpc だけを持つ入れ物。関数の名前ごとに答えを決める。決めていない関数は空の行を返す */
function storeWith(answers: Record<string, RpcAnswer>) {
  const rpc = jest.fn(async (...call: [name: string, args?: Record<string, unknown>]) => {
    const answer = answers[call[0]];
    return { data: answer?.data ?? [], error: answer?.error ?? null };
  });
  return { store: { rpc } as unknown as RefundStore, rpc };
}

/** 版の頭の数字は本番に当てる時に付け替わるので、移行のファイルは名前の後ろで探す */
function migrationText(suffix: string): string {
  const directory = path.join(process.cwd(), 'supabase/migrations');
  const files = fs.readdirSync(directory).filter((name) => name.endsWith(suffix));
  expect(files).toHaveLength(1);
  return fs.readFileSync(path.join(directory, files[0]), 'utf8');
}

// 管理画面の返金（道 admin）を始める入力。X を発送前に 1 個、Y を発送後に 1 個、送料 500

};

};

const SETTINGS_INPUT = { autoRefundCancelledOrderPayment: false, autoCancelAmountMismatch: true, actorId: ACTOR_ID };

// 取り消した注文への入金の受け取った額を書く入力（本計画 P27）
const CANCELLED_PAID_INPUT = { orderId: ORDER_ID, paymentIntentId: PAYMENT_INTENT_ID, receivedAmount: 8500 };

// DB の関数が止める言葉 → 誤りの記号（共通の約束 C-2）
const DB_WORDS = [
  ['ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 'order_not_found'],
  ['ORDER_NOT_REFUNDABLE', 'order_not_refundable'],
  ['ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE', 'order_not_cancellable'],
  ['AWAITING_REFUND_EXISTS', 'awaiting_refund_exists'],
  ['REFUND_REQUEST_MISMATCH', 'refund_request_mismatch'],
  ['REFUND_LINE_NOT_IN_ORDER', 'refund_line_not_in_order'],
  ['REFUND_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_UNSHIPPED', 'quantity_exceeds_unshipped'],
  ['REFUND_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_SHIPPED', 'quantity_exceeds_shipped'],
  ['REFUND_SHIPPING_EXCEEDS', 'shipping_exceeds'],
  ['REFUND_EXCEEDS_REFUNDABLE', 'exceeds_refundable'],
  ['REFUND_MUST_INCLUDE_UNSHIPPED', 'must_include_unshipped'],
  ['REFUND_MUST_BE_FULL', 'must_be_full'],
  ['REFUND_ARGUMENT_INVALID', 'invalid_argument'],
  ['SETTINGS_ARGUMENT_INVALID', 'invalid_argument'],
] as const satisfies ReadonlyArray<readonly [string, RefundErrorCode]>;

// TS が呼ぶ DB の関数（移行 B・C。load_order_refund_materials は refund-materials.ts が呼ぶ）
const RPC_NAMES = [
  'begin_order_refund',
  'get_order_refund',
  'load_order_refund_materials',
  'list_order_refunds',
  'list_awaiting_order_refunds',
  'list_pending_refund_payment_intents',
  'get_shop_settings',
  'admin_update_shop_settings',
  'record_order_refund_result',
  'record_external_order_refund',
  'mark_order_refund_error',
  'record_cancelled_order_paid_amount',
  'list_order_refund_summaries',
  'resolve_payment_exception_by_system',
];

describe('toRefundErrorCode', () => {
  it.each(DB_WORDS)('DB の言葉 %s は %s', (word, code) => {
    expect(toRefundErrorCode(word)).toBe(code);
    // PostgREST は言葉の前後に別の文を足すことがある
    expect(toRefundErrorCode(`error: ${word} (detail)`)).toBe(code);
  });

  it('13の記号が全部、どれかの DB の言葉から届く', () => {
    expect(new Set(DB_WORDS.map(([, code]) => code))).toEqual(new Set(REFUND_ERROR_CODES));
  });

  it('言葉は長い物から先に照らす: 2つの言葉が両方入った文は、表に書いた順ではなく、長い方の記号になる（Review Focus 3）', () => {
    // REFUND_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_UNSHIPPED を REFUND_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_SHIPPED より先に照らす
    expect(toRefundErrorCode('REFUND_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_SHIPPED / REFUND_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_UNSHIPPED')).toBe('quantity_exceeds_unshipped');
    expect(toRefundErrorCode('REFUND_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_UNSHIPPED / REFUND_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_SHIPPED')).toBe('quantity_exceeds_unshipped');
    // 表の先頭の短い ORDER_NOT_FOUND より、後ろの長い REFUND_MUST_BE_FULL が先に当たる
    expect(toRefundErrorCode('ORDER_NOT_FOUND / REFUND_MUST_BE_FULL')).toBe('must_be_full');
    expect(toRefundErrorCode('REFUND_MUST_BE_FULL / ORDER_NOT_FOUND')).toBe('must_be_full');
  });

  it('表に無い言葉・空・undefined は null', () => {
    expect(toRefundErrorCode('TOO_MANY_ORDERS')).toBeNull();
    expect(toRefundErrorCode('REFUND_NOT_FOUND')).toBeNull();
    expect(toRefundErrorCode('connection refused')).toBeNull();
    expect(toRefundErrorCode('')).toBeNull();
    expect(toRefundErrorCode(undefined)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('DB の関数が止める言葉は、移行の本文にある（綴りが食い違うと、画面に出る言葉が変わる）', () => {
    const sql = `${migrationText('_order_refund_requests.sql')}\n${migrationText('_order_refund_results.sql')}`;

    for (const [word] of DB_WORDS) {
      expect(sql).toContain(word);
    }
  });

  it('TS が呼ぶ DB の関数の名前は、移行の本文にある（名前が食い違うと、呼んだ時に初めて分かる）', () => {
    const sql = `${migrationText('_order_refund_requests.sql')}\n${migrationText('_order_refund_results.sql')}`;

    for (const name of RPC_NAMES) {
      expect(sql).toContain(`FUNCTION public.${name}(`);
    }
  });
});

describe('知らない DB の失敗は、どの呼び出しでも RefundStoreError（DB の文はメッセージに入れず、cause にだけ残す）', () => {
  const dbError = { message: '宛先・氏名を含む DB の文', code: '08006' };
  const CALLS: Array<[rpcName: string, run: (store: RefundStore) => Promise<unknown>]> = [
    ['begin_order_refund', (store) => beginOrderRefund(store, BEGIN_INPUT)],
    ['record_order_refund_result', (store) => recordOrderRefundResult(store, REFUND_ID, PENDING_FIELDS)],
    ['record_external_order_refund', (store) => recordExternalOrderRefund(store, EXTERNAL_INPUT)],
    ['mark_order_refund_error', (store) => markOrderRefundError(store, REFUND_ID, 'stripe_rejected', false)],
    ['record_cancelled_order_paid_amount', (store) => recordCancelledOrderPaidAmount(store, CANCELLED_PAID_INPUT)],
    ['get_order_refund', (store) => getOrderRefund(store, REFUND_ID)],
    ['list_order_refunds', (store) => listOrderRefunds(store, ORDER_ID)],
    ['list_awaiting_order_refunds', (store) => listAwaitingOrderRefunds(store, new Date('2026-10-11T02:45:00.000Z'), 20)],
    ['list_pending_refund_payment_intents', (store) => listPendingRefundPaymentIntents(store, 500)],
    ['list_order_refund_summaries', (store) => listOrderRefundSummaries(store, [ORDER_ID])],
    ['get_shop_settings', (store) => getShopSettings(store)],
    ['admin_update_shop_settings', (store) => updateShopSettings(store, SETTINGS_INPUT)],
    ['resolve_payment_exception_by_system', (store) => resolvePaymentExceptionBySystem(store, EXCEPTION_ID, 'メモ')],
  ];

  it.each(CALLS)('%s', async (rpcName, run) => {
    const { store } = storeWith({ [rpcName]: { error: dbError } });

    const error = (await run(store).catch((caught: unknown) => caught)) as RefundStoreError;

    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(RefundStoreError);
    expect(error).not.toBeInstanceOf(RefundOperationError);
    expect(error.message).toBe(`refund store failed: ${rpcName}`);
    expect(error.operation).toBe(rpcName);
    expect(error.code).toBe('08006');
    expect(error.cause).toEqual(dbError);
  });
});

  });
});

    expect(legacy.rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('record_external_order_refund', expect.objectContaining({ _stripe_reason: null }));

    const again = storeWith({ record_external_order_refund: { data: [{ ...EXTERNAL_ROW, created: false }] } });
    await expect(recordExternalOrderRefund(again.store, EXTERNAL_INPUT)).resolves.toMatchObject({ created: false });
  });

  it('注文が無い断りは記号 order_not_found', async () => {
    const { store } = storeWith({ record_external_order_refund: { error: { message: 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND', code: 'P0002' } } });

    await expect(recordExternalOrderRefund(store, EXTERNAL_INPUT)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'order_not_found' });

  it('行が返らなければ RefundStoreError', async () => {

describe('markOrderRefundError', () => {
  it('DB の関数の引数名のとおりに渡し、エラーにした結果と要対応の番号を返す', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({
      mark_order_refund_error: { data: [{ outcome: 'errored', order_id: ORDER_ID, exception_id: EXCEPTION_ID }] },
    });

    await expect(markOrderRefundError(store, REFUND_ID, 'not_found_in_stripe', true)).resolves.toEqual({
      outcome: 'errored', orderId: ORDER_ID, exceptionId: EXCEPTION_ID,
    });

    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('mark_order_refund_error', {
      _refund_id: REFUND_ID, _reason: 'not_found_in_stripe', _raise_exception: true,
    });
  });

  it('もう返事待ちではなければ not_awaiting（何度押しても同じ結果）。要対応は無い', async () => {
    const { store } = storeWith({
      mark_order_refund_error: { data: [{ outcome: 'not_awaiting', order_id: ORDER_ID, exception_id: null }] },
    });

    await expect(markOrderRefundError(store, REFUND_ID, 'stripe_rejected', false)).resolves.toEqual({
      outcome: 'not_awaiting', orderId: ORDER_ID, exceptionId: null,
    });
  });

  it('引数の誤りは記号 invalid_argument。知らない結果の言葉・行が無い答えは RefundStoreError', async () => {
    const invalid = storeWith({ mark_order_refund_error: { error: { message: 'REFUND_ARGUMENT_INVALID', code: '22023' } } });
    await expect(markOrderRefundError(invalid.store, REFUND_ID, 'x', false)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'invalid_argument' });

    const weird = storeWith({ mark_order_refund_error: { data: [{ outcome: 'weird', order_id: ORDER_ID, exception_id: null }] } });
    await expect(markOrderRefundError(weird.store, REFUND_ID, 'stripe_rejected', false)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(RefundStoreError);

    const empty = storeWith({ mark_order_refund_error: { data: [] } });
    await expect(markOrderRefundError(empty.store, REFUND_ID, 'stripe_rejected', false)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(RefundStoreError);
  });
});

describe('recordCancelledOrderPaidAmount（取り消した注文への入金の受け取った額。本計画 P27）', () => {
  it('DB の関数の引数名のとおりに渡し、書いたら true を返す', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({ record_cancelled_order_paid_amount: { data: true } });

    await expect(recordCancelledOrderPaidAmount(store, CANCELLED_PAID_INPUT)).resolves.toBe(true);

    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('record_cancelled_order_paid_amount', {
      _order_id: ORDER_ID, _payment_intent_id: PAYMENT_INTENT_ID, _received_amount: 8500,
    });
  });

  it('書かなかった時（取り消していない・書き済み・注文に別の支払いの番号がある）は false。誤りではない。答えが無い時も「書いた」とは読まない', async () => {
    const notWritten = storeWith({ record_cancelled_order_paid_amount: { data: false } });
    await expect(recordCancelledOrderPaidAmount(notWritten.store, CANCELLED_PAID_INPUT)).resolves.toBe(false);

    // boolean を返す関数なので、PostgREST の答えは true か false そのもの。storeWith は決めていない答えを空の配列にする
    const noAnswer = storeWith({});
    await expect(recordCancelledOrderPaidAmount(noAnswer.store, CANCELLED_PAID_INPUT)).resolves.toBe(false);
  });

  // 表に無い DB の失敗が RefundStoreError になることは、上の「知らない DB の失敗は、どの呼び出しでも RefundStoreError」の表がこの関数も確かめている
  it.each([
    ['REFUND_ARGUMENT_INVALID', 'invalid_argument', '22023'],
    ['ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 'order_not_found', 'P0002'],
  ] as const)('DB が %s で断れば、記号 %s を持つ RefundOperationError', async (word, code, sqlstate) => {
    const { store } = storeWith({ record_cancelled_order_paid_amount: { error: { message: word, code: sqlstate } } });

    const error = await recordCancelledOrderPaidAmount(store, CANCELLED_PAID_INPUT).catch((caught: unknown) => caught);

    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(RefundOperationError);
    expect(error).toMatchObject({ code });
  });
});

describe('getOrderRefund', () => {
  it('返金1件の要点を窓口の形に直す。送り直しと確かめ直しで同じ中身を Stripe に頼むための理由と実行した人も写す。支払いの番号が空でもよい', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({
      get_order_refund: {
        data: [{
          refund_id: REFUND_ID, order_id: ORDER_ID, source: 'admin', status: 'awaiting_response', stripe_refund_id: null,
          amount: 4055, payment_intent_id: null, created_at: '2026-10-11T02:00:00+00:00',
          stripe_reason: 'requested_by_customer', actor_id: ACTOR_ID, stripe_failure_reason: null,
        }],
      },
    });

    await expect(getOrderRefund(store, REFUND_ID)).resolves.toEqual({
      refundId: REFUND_ID, orderId: ORDER_ID, source: 'admin', status: 'awaiting_response', stripeRefundId: null,
      amount: 4055, paymentIntentId: null, createdAt: '2026-10-11T02:00:00+00:00',
      stripeReason: 'requested_by_customer', actorId: ACTOR_ID, failureReason: null,
    });
    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('get_order_refund', { _refund_id: REFUND_ID });
  });

  it('Stripe の番号と支払いの番号があれば写す。理由も実行した人も無い返金（Stripe の画面から）は null で写す。返金が無ければ null', async () => {
    const found = storeWith({
      get_order_refund: {
        data: [{
          refund_id: REFUND_ID, order_id: ORDER_ID, source: 'stripe_dashboard', status: 'succeeded', stripe_refund_id: STRIPE_REFUND_ID,
          amount: 8500, payment_intent_id: PAYMENT_INTENT_ID, created_at: '2026-10-11T02:00:00+00:00',
          stripe_reason: null, actor_id: null, stripe_failure_reason: null,
        }],
      },
    });
    await expect(getOrderRefund(found.store, REFUND_ID)).resolves.toMatchObject({
      stripeRefundId: STRIPE_REFUND_ID, paymentIntentId: PAYMENT_INTENT_ID, stripeReason: null, actorId: null, failureReason: null,
    });

    const none = storeWith({ get_order_refund: { data: [] } });
    await expect(getOrderRefund(none.store, REFUND_ID)).resolves.toBeNull();
  });

  it('エラー・失敗の返金は、失敗の理由（こちらの理由 stripe_rejected か Stripe の記号）も写す', async () => {
    const { store } = storeWith({
      get_order_refund: {
        data: [{
          refund_id: REFUND_ID, order_id: ORDER_ID, source: 'admin', status: 'error', stripe_refund_id: null,
          amount: 4055, payment_intent_id: PAYMENT_INTENT_ID, created_at: '2026-10-11T02:00:00+00:00',
          stripe_reason: 'fraudulent', actor_id: ACTOR_ID, stripe_failure_reason: 'stripe_rejected',
        }],
      },
    });

    await expect(getOrderRefund(store, REFUND_ID)).resolves.toMatchObject({
      status: 'error', stripeReason: 'fraudulent', actorId: ACTOR_ID, failureReason: 'stripe_rejected',
    });

describe('listOrderRefunds', () => {
  const REFUND_ROW = {
    refund_id: REFUND_ID, source: 'admin', status: 'succeeded', stripe_status: 'succeeded', stripe_pending_reason: null,
    stripe_failure_reason: null, customer_action_expires_at: null, payment_method_type: 'card', amount: 4055,
    shipping_amount: 500, adjustment_amount: 0, note: '返品の相談あり', stripe_reason: 'requested_by_customer',
    cancel_reason: null, notify_customer: true, actor_email: 'admin@example.com', reference_number: '74123456789012345678901',
    reference_type: 'acquirer_reference_number', created_at: '2026-10-11T02:00:00+00:00', accepted_at: '2026-10-11T02:00:01+00:00',
    succeeded_at: '2026-10-11T02:00:02+00:00', failed_at: null, errored_at: null,
    lines: [{
      order_item_id: ITEM_1, quantity: 1, before_shipment: true, restock_type: 'cancel', amount: 2666, released_quantity: 1,
      restocked_quantity: 1, rereserved_quantity: 0, rereserve_shortage: 0,
    }],
  };

  it('返金の一覧を窓口の形に直す。商品の行は jsonb の配列から読む', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({ list_order_refunds: { data: [REFUND_ROW] } });

    await expect(listOrderRefunds(store, ORDER_ID)).resolves.toEqual([{
      refundId: REFUND_ID,
      source: 'admin',
      status: 'succeeded',
      stripeStatus: 'succeeded',
      pendingReason: null,
      failureReason: null,
      customerActionExpiresAt: null,
      paymentMethodType: 'card',
      amount: 4055,
      shippingAmount: 500,
      adjustmentAmount: 0,
      note: '返品の相談あり',
      stripeReason: 'requested_by_customer',
      cancelReason: null,
      notifyCustomer: true,
      actorEmail: 'admin@example.com',
      referenceNumber: '74123456789012345678901',
      referenceType: 'acquirer_reference_number',
      createdAt: '2026-10-11T02:00:00+00:00',
      acceptedAt: '2026-10-11T02:00:01+00:00',
      succeededAt: '2026-10-11T02:00:02+00:00',
      failedAt: null,
      erroredAt: null,
      lines: [{
        orderItemId: ITEM_1, quantity: 1, beforeShipment: true, restockType: 'cancel', amount: 2666, releasedQuantity: 1,
        restockedQuantity: 1, rereservedQuantity: 0, rereserveShortage: 0,
      }],
    }]);
    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('list_order_refunds', { _order_id: ORDER_ID });
  });

  it('Stripe の画面からの返金（実行した人も商品の行も無い）と、保留・失敗の細目も読める', async () => {
    const { store } = storeWith({
      list_order_refunds: {
        data: [{
          ...REFUND_ROW, source: 'stripe_dashboard', status: 'failed', stripe_status: 'failed', stripe_failure_reason: 'expired',
          customer_action_expires_at: '2026-11-25T00:00:00+00:00', payment_method_type: 'konbini', note: null, stripe_reason: null,
          actor_email: null, reference_number: null, reference_type: null, succeeded_at: null, failed_at: '2026-11-26T00:00:00+00:00',
          lines: null,
        }],
      },
    });

    const [refund] = await listOrderRefunds(store, ORDER_ID);

    expect(refund).toMatchObject({
      source: 'stripe_dashboard', status: 'failed', failureReason: 'expired', customerActionExpiresAt: '2026-11-25T00:00:00+00:00',
      paymentMethodType: 'konbini', note: null, stripeReason: null, actorEmail: null, referenceNumber: null,
      succeededAt: null, failedAt: '2026-11-26T00:00:00+00:00', lines: [],
    });
  });

  it('取消の理由（道 order_cancel）を写す', async () => {
    const { store } = storeWith({
      list_order_refunds: { data: [{ ...REFUND_ROW, source: 'order_cancel', cancel_reason: 'customer_request' }] },
    });

    const [refund] = await listOrderRefunds(store, ORDER_ID);

    expect(refund).toMatchObject({ source: 'order_cancel', cancelReason: 'customer_request' });
  });

  describe('PostgREST の max_rows（1000）で答えが切れうる時', () => {
    const rows = (count: number) => Array.from({ length: count }, () => ({ ...REFUND_ROW }));

    it('1回の答えが 1000 行に届いたら、切れている恐れがあるので RefundStoreError で止める', async () => {
      const { store } = storeWith({ list_order_refunds: { data: rows(1000) } });

      const error = await listOrderRefunds(store, ORDER_ID).catch((caught: unknown) => caught);

      expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(RefundStoreError);
      expect(error).toMatchObject({ operation: 'list_order_refunds' });
    });

    it('999 行なら通る', async () => {
      const { store } = storeWith({ list_order_refunds: { data: rows(999) } });

      await expect(listOrderRefunds(store, ORDER_ID)).resolves.toHaveLength(999);
    });
  });
});

describe('listOrderRefundSummaries', () => {
  const summaryRow = (orderId: string, overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({
    order_id: orderId, paid_amount: 8500, succeeded_amount: 0, open_amount: 8500, refundable_amount: 0,
    has_open_refund: true, has_unresolved_refund_failure: false, ...overrides,
  });
  const summary = (orderId: string, overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({
    orderId, paidAmount: 8500, succeededAmount: 0, openAmount: 8500, refundableAmount: 0,
    hasOpenRefund: true, hasUnresolvedRefundFailure: false, ...overrides,
  });

  it('空の入力は DB を呼ばず、空の Map を返す', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({});

    await expect(listOrderRefundSummaries(store, [])).resolves.toEqual(new Map());

    expect(rpc).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('要約を注文ごとに集める。DB が行を返さなかった注文も、受け取った額 null・各額 0・印 false の要約でキーに入る', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({
      list_order_refund_summaries: {
        data: [
          summaryRow(ORDER_ID),
          summaryRow(OTHER_ORDER_ID, {
            paid_amount: null, open_amount: 0, has_open_refund: false, has_unresolved_refund_failure: true,
          }),
        ],
      },
    });

    const result = await listOrderRefundSummaries(store, [ORDER_ID, OTHER_ORDER_ID, EMPTY_ORDER_ID]);

    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('list_order_refund_summaries', { _order_ids: [ORDER_ID, OTHER_ORDER_ID, EMPTY_ORDER_ID] });
    expect([...result.keys()]).toEqual([ORDER_ID, OTHER_ORDER_ID, EMPTY_ORDER_ID]);
    expect(result.get(ORDER_ID)).toEqual(summary(ORDER_ID));
    expect(result.get(OTHER_ORDER_ID)).toEqual(
      summary(OTHER_ORDER_ID, { paidAmount: null, openAmount: 0, hasOpenRefund: false, hasUnresolvedRefundFailure: true }),
    );
    expect(result.get(EMPTY_ORDER_ID)).toEqual({
      orderId: EMPTY_ORDER_ID, paidAmount: null, succeededAmount: 0, openAmount: 0, refundableAmount: 0,
      hasOpenRefund: false, hasUnresolvedRefundFailure: false,
    });
  });

  it('同じ番号は1回として数える', async () => {
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({ list_order_refund_summaries: { data: [summaryRow(ORDER_ID)] } });

    const result = await listOrderRefundSummaries(store, [ORDER_ID, ORDER_ID]);

    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('list_order_refund_summaries', { _order_ids: [ORDER_ID] });
    expect(result.size).toBe(1);
  });

  it('大文字の番号を渡すと、RPC へは小文字で渡り、DB が小文字で返した行は渡した文字のキーに入る', async () => {
    const upper = ORDER_ID.toUpperCase();
    // 実際の DB は uuid をいつも小文字で返す
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({ list_order_refund_summaries: { data: [summaryRow(ORDER_ID)] } });

    const result = await listOrderRefundSummaries(store, [upper]);

    expect(rpc).toHaveBeenCalledWith('list_order_refund_summaries', { _order_ids: [ORDER_ID] });
    expect([...result.keys()]).toEqual([upper]);
    expect(result.get(upper)).toEqual(summary(ORDER_ID));
  });

  it('200件ずつに分けて呼ぶ（DB の関数は201件以上を断るため）。渡した番号は全部キーに入る', async () => {
    const ids = Array.from({ length: 450 }, (_, index) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(index).padStart(12, '0')}`);
    const { store, rpc } = storeWith({ list_order_refund_summaries: { data: [] } });

    const result = await listOrderRefundSummaries(store, ids);

    expect(rpc.mock.calls.map(([, args]) => (args?._order_ids as string[]).length)).toEqual([200, 200, 50]);
    expect(rpc.mock.calls[0][1]?._order_ids).toEqual(ids.slice(0, 200));
    expect(rpc.mock.calls[2][1]?._order_ids).toEqual(ids.slice(400));
    expect(result.size).toBe(450);
  });
});
```

```ts
  UpdateShopSettingsRequest,
} from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-types';

/**
 * 返金の DB の関数を呼ぶ（グループ E-2 設計書 3〜6・9 章）。返金の2つの表は service_role からも書けず、関数だけが書く。
 * 関数は断る理由を決まった言葉で止める。ここで誤りの記号（RefundErrorCode）に直し、窓口が HTTP と画面の言葉にする。
 * DB の文には宛先などが混ざりうるので、ログに出さない（RefundStoreError は呼び出しの名前と DB の記号だけを見せる）。
 * サーバーだけで使う（画面から読まない）。単体テストと DB 結合テストが直接読むので、サーバー専用の印（server-only）は付けない。
 */
export type RefundStore = Pick<SupabaseClient, 'rpc'>;

type QueryError = { message?: string; code?: string } | null;

/** DB の関数が決まった言葉で断った。記号から HTTP と画面の言葉が決まる */
export class RefundOperationError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly code: RefundErrorCode) {
    super(`refund operation refused: ${code}`);
    this.name = 'RefundOperationError';
  }
}

/** DB の呼び出しが思いがけず失敗した。DB の文は cause にだけ残す */
export class RefundStoreError extends Error {
  readonly code: string | null;

  constructor(
    readonly operation: string,
    cause: QueryError = null,
  ) {
    super(`refund store failed: ${operation}`, { cause });
    this.name = 'RefundStoreError';
    this.code = cause?.code ?? null;
  }
}

// DB の関数が RAISE EXCEPTION で止める言葉 → 誤りの記号（共通の約束 C-2）。言葉は移行の本文と同じ綴り
const DB_ERROR_WORDS: Array<readonly [string, RefundErrorCode]> = [
  ['ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 'order_not_found'],
  ['ORDER_NOT_REFUNDABLE', 'order_not_refundable'],
  ['ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE', 'order_not_cancellable'],
  ['AWAITING_REFUND_EXISTS', 'awaiting_refund_exists'],
  ['REFUND_REQUEST_MISMATCH', 'refund_request_mismatch'],
  ['REFUND_LINE_NOT_IN_ORDER', 'refund_line_not_in_order'],
  ['REFUND_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_UNSHIPPED', 'quantity_exceeds_unshipped'],
  ['REFUND_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_SHIPPED', 'quantity_exceeds_shipped'],
  ['REFUND_SHIPPING_EXCEEDS', 'shipping_exceeds'],
  ['REFUND_EXCEEDS_REFUNDABLE', 'exceeds_refundable'],
  ['REFUND_MUST_INCLUDE_UNSHIPPED', 'must_include_unshipped'],
  ['REFUND_MUST_BE_FULL', 'must_be_full'],
  ['REFUND_ARGUMENT_INVALID', 'invalid_argument'],
  ['SETTINGS_ARGUMENT_INVALID', 'invalid_argument'],
];
// 長い言葉から先に照らす。ある言葉が別の言葉の一部になる綴りが足されても、長い方が先に当たる（本計画 P3）
DB_ERROR_WORDS.sort((a, b) => b[0].length - a[0].length);

/** DB の誤りの文に表の言葉が含まれていれば、その記号。無ければ null */
export function toRefundErrorCode(message: string | undefined): RefundErrorCode | null {
  if (!message) {
    return null;
  }
  return DB_ERROR_WORDS.find(([word]) => message.includes(word))?.[1] ?? null;
}

type RefundRpcName =
  | 'begin_order_refund'
  | 'record_order_refund_result'
  | 'record_external_order_refund'
  | 'mark_order_refund_error'
  | 'record_cancelled_order_paid_amount'
  | 'get_order_refund'
  | 'list_order_refunds'
  | 'list_awaiting_order_refunds'
  | 'list_pending_refund_payment_intents'
  | 'list_order_refund_summaries'
  | 'get_shop_settings'
  | 'admin_update_shop_settings'
  | 'resolve_payment_exception_by_system';

async function callRpc(store: RefundStore, name: RefundRpcName, args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<unknown> {
  const { data, error } = await store.rpc(name, args);
  if (error) {
    const code = toRefundErrorCode(error.message);
    throw code ? new RefundOperationError(code) : new RefundStoreError(name, error);
  }
  return data;
}

/** PostgREST は表を返す関数の答えを配列で返す。行が1つのオブジェクトで来ても読めるようにする */
function rowsOf(data: unknown): Record<string, unknown>[] {
  if (Array.isArray(data)) return data as Record<string, unknown>[];
  return data && typeof data === 'object' ? [data as Record<string, unknown>] : [];
}

// PostgREST が1回の答えで返す行の上限。値は supabase/config.toml の max_rows と本番の既定（どちらも 1000）に合わせる
// （fulfillment-store.ts と同じ値）。上限に届いた答えは切れている恐れがあり、切れたまま使うと一覧や判定を誤るので、使わずに止める
const POSTGREST_MAX_ROWS = 1000;

/** 一覧を返す関数の答えの行。上限に届いていたら RefundStoreError で止める */
function listRowsOf(data: unknown, operation: RefundRpcName): Record<string, unknown>[] {
  const rows = rowsOf(data);
  if (rows.length >= POSTGREST_MAX_ROWS) {
    throw new RefundStoreError(operation);
  }
  return rows;
}

function textOrNull(value: unknown): string | null {
  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : null;
}

export type BeginRefundInput = {
  orderId: string;
  source: Exclude<OrderRefundSource, 'stripe_dashboard' | 'legacy'>;
  requestKey: string | null;
  lines: RefundLineRequest[];
  restock: boolean;
  shippingAmount: number;
  amount: number;
  note: string | null;
  stripeReason: StripeRefundReason | null;
  cancelReason: CancelReason | null;
  notifyCustomer: boolean;
  actorId: string | null;
  receivedAmount?: number | null;
};

export type BeganRefund = { refundId: string; amount: number; status: OrderRefundStatus; replayed: boolean };

/**
 * 返金の記録を「返事待ち」で始める（Stripe に頼む前）。同じ requestKey の送り直しは前の記録を返す（replayed）。
 * 道 admin・order_cancel は requestKey が要り、自動の返金（auto_*）は空。断りは RefundOperationError
 */
export async function beginOrderRefund(store: RefundStore, input: BeginRefundInput): Promise<BeganRefund> {
  const row = rowsOf(
    await callRpc(store, 'begin_order_refund', {
      _order_id: input.orderId,
      _source: input.source,
      _request_key: input.requestKey,
      _lines: input.lines.map((line) => ({
        order_item_id: line.orderItemId,
        quantity: line.quantity,
        before_shipment: line.beforeShipment,
      })),
      _restock: input.restock,
      _shipping_amount: input.shippingAmount,
      _amount: input.amount,
      _note: input.note,
      _stripe_reason: input.stripeReason,
      _cancel_reason: input.cancelReason,
      _notify_customer: input.notifyCustomer,
      _actor_id: input.actorId,
      _received_amount: input.receivedAmount ?? null,
    }),
  )[0];
  if (!row) {
    throw new RefundStoreError('begin_order_refund', null);
  }
  return {
    refundId: String(row.refund_id),
    amount: Number(row.amount),
    status: row.status as OrderRefundStatus,
    replayed: row.replayed === true,
  };
}

/** Stripe の返金から読んだ値（結果を書く関数に渡す） */
export type StripeRefundFields = {
  stripeRefundId: string;
  stripeStatus: string;
  pendingReason: string | null;
  failureReason: string | null;
  customerActionExpiresAt: string | null;
  paymentMethodType: string | null;
  referenceNumber: string | null;
  referenceType: string | null;
};

export type RefundResultRow = {
  refundId: string;
  orderId: string;
  status: OrderRefundStatus;
  newlyAccepted: boolean;
  newlyFailed: boolean;
  orderStatus: OrderStatus;
  refundedAmount: number;
  rereserveShortage: number;
  emailEnqueued: boolean;
  exceptionId: string | null;
};

/** 結果を書く関数に渡す Stripe の返金の値。引数名は DB の関数のとおり */
function stripeFieldArgs(fields: StripeRefundFields) {
  return {
    _stripe_refund_id: fields.stripeRefundId,
    _stripe_status: fields.stripeStatus,
    _stripe_pending_reason: fields.pendingReason,
    _stripe_failure_reason: fields.failureReason,
    _customer_action_expires_at: fields.customerActionExpiresAt,
    _payment_method_type: fields.paymentMethodType,
    _reference_number: fields.referenceNumber,
    _reference_type: fields.referenceType,
  };
}

/** 結果を書く2つの関数の答えの行。注文の番号は呼ぶ側が渡す（外からの返金の関数は注文の番号の列を返さない） */
function toResultRow(row: Record<string, unknown>, orderId: string): RefundResultRow {
  return {
    refundId: String(row.refund_id),
    orderId,
    status: row.status as OrderRefundStatus,
    newlyAccepted: row.newly_accepted === true,
    newlyFailed: row.newly_failed === true,
    orderStatus: row.order_status as OrderStatus,
    refundedAmount: Number(row.refunded_amount),
    rereserveShortage: Number(row.rereserve_shortage),
    emailEnqueued: row.email_enqueued === true,
    exceptionId: textOrNull(row.exception_id),
  };
}

/**
 * Stripe の返金の値で、記録の状態を進める。在庫・メールの予定・要対応・注文の額と状態を DB が1回の取引で書く。
 * 前の状態に戻る知らせ（成功の後の保留など）は、DB が何もせずに今の値を返す
 */
export async function recordOrderRefundResult(
  store: RefundStore,
  refundId: string,
  fields: StripeRefundFields,
): Promise<RefundResultRow> {
  const row = rowsOf(
    await callRpc(store, 'record_order_refund_result', { _refund_id: refundId, ...stripeFieldArgs(fields) }),
  )[0];
  if (!row) {
    throw new RefundStoreError('record_order_refund_result', null);
  }
  return toResultRow(row, String(row.order_id));
}

export type ExternalRefundResultRow = RefundResultRow & { created: boolean; source: OrderRefundSource };

/**
 * こちらの印の無い返金（Stripe の画面からの返金・切り替えの前の写し）を記録する。同じ Stripe の返金の番号は何度呼んでも1行
 * （created が false）。DB の関数は注文の番号を返さないので、答えの orderId は入力の値を写す
 */
export async function recordExternalOrderRefund(
  store: RefundStore,
  input: {
    orderId: string;
    amount: number;
    stripeReason: string | null;
    stripeCreatedAt: string;
  } & StripeRefundFields,
): Promise<ExternalRefundResultRow> {
  const row = rowsOf(
    await callRpc(store, 'record_external_order_refund', {
      _order_id: input.orderId,
      _amount: input.amount,
      _stripe_reason: input.stripeReason,
      _stripe_created_at: input.stripeCreatedAt,
      ...stripeFieldArgs(input),
    }),
  )[0];
  if (!row) {
    throw new RefundStoreError('record_external_order_refund', null);
  }
  return { ...toResultRow(row, input.orderId), created: row.created === true, source: row.source as OrderRefundSource };
}

function markOutcomeOf(value: unknown): 'errored' | 'not_awaiting' | null {
  return value === 'errored' || value === 'not_awaiting' ? value : null;
}

/**
 * 返事待ちの返金をエラーにする（Stripe の断り・見回りで見つからない）。raiseException が true なら要対応「返金の失敗」も作る。
 * もう返事待ちでなければ not_awaiting（何度呼んでも同じ結果）
 */
export async function markOrderRefundError(
  store: RefundStore,
  refundId: string,
  reason: string,
  raiseException: boolean,
): Promise<{ outcome: 'errored' | 'not_awaiting'; orderId: string; exceptionId: string | null }> {
  const row = rowsOf(
    await callRpc(store, 'mark_order_refund_error', {
      _refund_id: refundId,
      _reason: reason,
      _raise_exception: raiseException,
    }),
  )[0];
  const outcome = markOutcomeOf(row?.outcome);
  if (!outcome) {
    throw new RefundStoreError('mark_order_refund_error', null);
  }
  return { outcome, orderId: String(row.order_id), exceptionId: textOrNull(row.exception_id) };
}

/**
 * 取り消した注文への入金の受け取った額を書く（本計画 P27）。照合が要対応「取り消した注文への入金」を記録するたびに、
 * 自動の返金①より先に呼ぶ（①のオン・オフに依らず、店が管理画面から返金できるように）。
 * 書いたら true。取り消していない注文・書き済みの注文・注文に別の支払いの番号がある時は、何も書かずに false（何度呼んでも同じ）。
 * DB の決まった言葉（REFUND_ARGUMENT_INVALID・ORDER_NOT_FOUND）は RefundOperationError、ほかの DB の誤りは RefundStoreError。
 * boolean を返す関数なので、PostgREST の答えは行の配列ではなく true か false そのもの
 */
export async function recordCancelledOrderPaidAmount(
  store: RefundStore,
  input: { orderId: string; paymentIntentId: string; receivedAmount: number },
): Promise<boolean> {
  const data = await callRpc(store, 'record_cancelled_order_paid_amount', {
    _order_id: input.orderId,
    _payment_intent_id: input.paymentIntentId,
    _received_amount: input.receivedAmount,
  });
  return data === true;
}

export type OrderRefundRef = {
  refundId: string;
  orderId: string;
  source: OrderRefundSource;
  status: OrderRefundStatus;
  stripeRefundId: string | null;
  amount: number;
  paymentIntentId: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  stripeReason: StripeRefundReason | null;
  actorId: string | null;
  failureReason: string | null;
};

/**
 * 返金1件の要点。Stripe の返金の印が、この注文の記録に当たるかを調べる時と、返事待ちの記録を送り直す・確かめ直す時に使う。
 * 送り直しと確かめ直しは記録と同じ中身で Stripe に頼むので、額のほかに、Stripe に伝える理由と実行した人（印 actor_id 用）も返す。
 * failureReason は、エラー・失敗の記録の理由（こちらの理由 stripe_rejected か Stripe の記号）。無ければ null
 */
export async function getOrderRefund(store: RefundStore, refundId: string): Promise<OrderRefundRef | null> {
  const row = rowsOf(await callRpc(store, 'get_order_refund', { _refund_id: refundId }))[0];
  if (!row) {
    return null;
  }
  return {
    refundId: String(row.refund_id),
    orderId: String(row.order_id),
    source: row.source as OrderRefundSource,
    status: row.status as OrderRefundStatus,
    stripeRefundId: textOrNull(row.stripe_refund_id),
    amount: Number(row.amount),
    paymentIntentId: textOrNull(row.payment_intent_id),
    createdAt: String(row.created_at),
    stripeReason: textOrNull(row.stripe_reason) as StripeRefundReason | null,
    actorId: textOrNull(row.actor_id),
    failureReason: textOrNull(row.stripe_failure_reason),
  };
}

export type OrderRefundLineRow = {
  orderItemId: string;
  quantity: number;
  beforeShipment: boolean;
  restockType: 'cancel' | 'no_restock';
  amount: number;
  releasedQuantity: number;
  restockedQuantity: number;
  rereservedQuantity: number;
  rereserveShortage: number;
};

export type OrderRefundRow = {
  refundId: string;
  source: OrderRefundSource;
  status: OrderRefundStatus;
  stripeStatus: string | null;
  pendingReason: string | null;
  failureReason: string | null;
  customerActionExpiresAt: string | null;
  paymentMethodType: string | null;
  amount: number;
  shippingAmount: number;
  adjustmentAmount: number;
  note: string | null;
  stripeReason: StripeRefundReason | null;
  cancelReason: CancelReason | null;
  notifyCustomer: boolean;
  actorEmail: string | null;
  referenceNumber: string | null;
  referenceType: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  acceptedAt: string | null;
  succeededAt: string | null;
  failedAt: string | null;
  erroredAt: string | null;
  lines: OrderRefundLineRow[];
};

/** list_order_refunds の lines（jsonb の配列。商品の行が無ければ null になりうる）を窓口の形に直す */
function fromDbLines(value: unknown): OrderRefundLineRow[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  return value.map((line: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
    orderItemId: String(line.order_item_id),
    quantity: Number(line.quantity),
    beforeShipment: line.before_shipment === true,
    restockType: line.restock_type === 'cancel' ? 'cancel' : 'no_restock',
    amount: Number(line.amount),
    releasedQuantity: Number(line.released_quantity),
    restockedQuantity: Number(line.restocked_quantity),
    rereservedQuantity: Number(line.rereserved_quantity),
    rereserveShortage: Number(line.rereserve_shortage),
  }));
}

/**
 * 注文の返金の一覧（失敗・エラーも含む。新しい順）。操作した人のメールを含むので、答えをそのまま返さない。
 * 管理画面の履歴の窓口が使う。お客様の窓口が使う時は、項目を名指しで選んでから返すこと（失敗とエラーの返金は返さない）
 */
export async function listOrderRefunds(store: RefundStore, orderId: string): Promise<OrderRefundRow[]> {
  const data = await callRpc(store, 'list_order_refunds', { _order_id: orderId });
  return listRowsOf(data, 'list_order_refunds').map((row) => ({
    refundId: String(row.refund_id),
    source: row.source as OrderRefundSource,
    status: row.status as OrderRefundStatus,
    stripeStatus: textOrNull(row.stripe_status),
    pendingReason: textOrNull(row.stripe_pending_reason),
    failureReason: textOrNull(row.stripe_failure_reason),
    customerActionExpiresAt: textOrNull(row.customer_action_expires_at),
    paymentMethodType: textOrNull(row.payment_method_type),
    amount: Number(row.amount),
    shippingAmount: Number(row.shipping_amount),
    adjustmentAmount: Number(row.adjustment_amount),
    note: textOrNull(row.note),
    stripeReason: textOrNull(row.stripe_reason) as StripeRefundReason | null,
    cancelReason: textOrNull(row.cancel_reason) as CancelReason | null,
    notifyCustomer: row.notify_customer === true,
    actorEmail: textOrNull(row.actor_email),
    referenceNumber: textOrNull(row.reference_number),
    referenceType: textOrNull(row.reference_type),
    createdAt: String(row.created_at),
    acceptedAt: textOrNull(row.accepted_at),
    succeededAt: textOrNull(row.succeeded_at),
    failedAt: textOrNull(row.failed_at),
    erroredAt: textOrNull(row.errored_at),
    lines: fromDbLines(row.lines),
  }));
}

/** 見回りが Stripe で確かめる、olderThan より前から返事待ちの返金（古い順）。limit は DB が 1〜200 に丸める */
export async function listAwaitingOrderRefunds(
  store: RefundStore,
  olderThan: Date,
  limit: number,
): Promise<Array<{ refundId: string; orderId: string; paymentIntentId: string | null; createdAt: string }>> {
  const data = await callRpc(store, 'list_awaiting_order_refunds', { _older_than: olderThan.toISOString(), _limit: limit });
  return listRowsOf(data, 'list_awaiting_order_refunds').map((row) => ({
    refundId: String(row.refund_id),
    orderId: String(row.order_id),
    paymentIntentId: textOrNull(row.payment_intent_id),
    createdAt: String(row.created_at),
  }));
}

/** 保留の返金がある注文の支払いの番号（重複なし）。毎晩の照合が合わせる。limit は DB が 1〜500 に丸める */
export async function listPendingRefundPaymentIntents(store: RefundStore, limit: number): Promise<string[]> {
  const data = await callRpc(store, 'list_pending_refund_payment_intents', { _limit: limit });
  return listRowsOf(data, 'list_pending_refund_payment_intents').map((row) => String(row.payment_intent_id));
}

export type OrderRefundSummary = {
  orderId: string;
  paidAmount: number | null;
  succeededAmount: number;
  openAmount: number;
  refundableAmount: number;
  hasOpenRefund: boolean;
  hasUnresolvedRefundFailure: boolean;
};

// DB の関数 list_order_refund_summaries が一度に受ける注文の数の上限
const SUMMARY_CHUNK_SIZE = 200;

/** DB が行を返さなかった注文の要約。受け取った額は無く、返金の手続きも失敗も無い */
function emptySummary(orderId: string): OrderRefundSummary {
  return {
    orderId,
    paidAmount: null,
    succeededAmount: 0,
    openAmount: 0,
    refundableAmount: 0,
    hasOpenRefund: false,
    hasUnresolvedRefundFailure: false,
  };
}

/**
 * 注文ごとの返金の要約（一覧の支払いの列・返金とキャンセルのボタンの判定に使う）。渡した番号は全部キーに入る
 * （渡した文字のまま。DB が行を返さなかった注文は空の要約）。空なら DB を呼ばない。
 * DB の関数が受ける上限に合わせて、200件ずつに分けて呼ぶ。
 */
export async function listOrderRefundSummaries(
  store: RefundStore,
  orderIds: readonly string[],
): Promise<Map<string, OrderRefundSummary>> {
  // DB は uuid を小文字で返す。窓口の uuid 検証は大文字も通すので、小文字にそろえて引かないと行が合わず捨てられる
  const ids = [...new Set(orderIds.map((id) => id.toLowerCase()))];
  const summaryById = new Map<string, OrderRefundSummary>();

  for (let start = 0; start < ids.length; start += SUMMARY_CHUNK_SIZE) {
    const data = await callRpc(store, 'list_order_refund_summaries', {
      _order_ids: ids.slice(start, start + SUMMARY_CHUNK_SIZE),
    });
    for (const row of listRowsOf(data, 'list_order_refund_summaries')) {
      const orderId = String(row.order_id).toLowerCase();
      summaryById.set(orderId, {
        orderId,
        paidAmount: typeof row.paid_amount === 'number' ? row.paid_amount : null,
        succeededAmount: Number(row.succeeded_amount),
        openAmount: Number(row.open_amount),
        refundableAmount: Number(row.refundable_amount),
        hasOpenRefund: row.has_open_refund === true,
        hasUnresolvedRefundFailure: row.has_unresolved_refund_failure === true,
      });
    }
  }
  return new Map(
    [...new Set(orderIds)].map((id): [string, OrderRefundSummary] => [
      id,
      summaryById.get(id.toLowerCase()) ?? emptySummary(id.toLowerCase()),
    ]),
  );
}

export type ShopSettingsRow = ShopSettings & { refundLedgerStartedAt: string };

function toggleOf(enabled: unknown, updatedAt: unknown, updatedByEmail: unknown): ShopSettingToggle {
  return { enabled: enabled === true, updatedAt: textOrNull(updatedAt), updatedByEmail: textOrNull(updatedByEmail) };
}

function toShopSettings(row: Record<string, unknown>): ShopSettingsRow {
  return {
    autoRefundCancelledOrderPayment: toggleOf(
      row.auto_refund_cancelled_order_payment,
      row.auto_refund_cancelled_order_payment_updated_at,
      row.auto_refund_cancelled_order_payment_updated_by_email,
    ),
    autoCancelAmountMismatch: toggleOf(
      row.auto_cancel_amount_mismatch,
      row.auto_cancel_amount_mismatch_updated_at,
      row.auto_cancel_amount_mismatch_updated_by_email,
    ),
    refundLedgerStartedAt: String(row.refund_ledger_started_at),
  };
}

/** ショップの設定（1行だけ）。最後に変えた人のメールを含むので、管理画面の窓口だけが使う */
export async function getShopSettings(store: RefundStore): Promise<ShopSettingsRow> {
  const row = rowsOf(await callRpc(store, 'get_shop_settings', {}))[0];
  if (!row) {
    throw new RefundStoreError('get_shop_settings', null);
  }
  return toShopSettings(row);
}

/** ショップの設定を変える。変わったトグルだけ、その更新者と時刻が書き換わる。変えた後の設定を返す */
export async function updateShopSettings(
  store: RefundStore,
  input: UpdateShopSettingsRequest & { actorId: string },
): Promise<ShopSettingsRow> {
  const row = rowsOf(
    await callRpc(store, 'admin_update_shop_settings', {
      _auto_refund_cancelled_order_payment: input.autoRefundCancelledOrderPayment,
      _auto_cancel_amount_mismatch: input.autoCancelAmountMismatch,
      _actor_id: input.actorId,
    }),
  )[0];
  if (!row) {
    throw new RefundStoreError('admin_update_shop_settings', null);
  }
  return toShopSettings(row);
}

/**
 * 要対応を「システムが自動で解決した」と閉じる（解決した人は空）。閉じたら true、もう閉じていれば false。
 * boolean を返す関数なので、PostgREST の答えは行の配列ではなく true か false そのもの
 */
export async function resolvePaymentExceptionBySystem(
  store: RefundStore,
  exceptionId: string,
  note: string,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const data = await callRpc(store, 'resolve_payment_exception_by_system', { _exception_id: exceptionId, _note: note });
  return data === true;
}
```

`src/lib/orders/refund/refund-materials.ts`:

```ts
import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { toOrderNumber } from '@/lib/orders/order-number';
import type { OrderStatus } from '@/lib/orders/order-payment-types';
import { RefundStoreError } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-store';
import type { RefundMaterialLine, RefundMaterials, RefundPaymentMethod } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-types';

type MaterialItemRow = { id: string; item_name: string; color: string | null; size: string | null };

/**
 * 返金の画面の支払い方法。お客様の注文の窓口（src/app/api/orders/[id]/route.ts）と同じく checkout_drafts.payment_method から読む。
 * 値は stripe_card・stripe_paypay・stripe_konbini・link のほか、Stripe の種別がそのまま入る（mapStripePaymentMethodType）。
 * 返金の案内を分ける4つ以外は unknown にする。実際に返金を頼む時の支払いの種類は、Stripe の支払いから読む（本計画 P10）。
 */
function toPaymentMethod(value: string | null): RefundPaymentMethod {
  switch (value) {
    case 'stripe_card':
      return 'card';
    case 'link':
      return 'link';
    case 'stripe_paypay':
      return 'paypay';
    case 'stripe_konbini':
      return 'konbini';
    default:
      return 'unknown';
  }
}

/** DB の材料の lines（jsonb の配列）を、商品の番号で引ける形にする */
function countsByItemId(value: unknown): Map<string, Record<string, unknown>> {
  const lines = Array.isArray(value) ? (value as Record<string, unknown>[]) : [];
  return new Map(lines.map((line) => [String(line.order_item_id), line] as const));
}

/**
 * 返金の画面が開いた時に読む材料（グループ E-2 設計書 5-2）。service_role の client で読む。注文が無ければ null。
 * 数・金額・割り振った割引は DB の関数 load_order_refund_materials が出す（数え方は DB の1か所）。
 * ここでは、商品の名前・色・サイズ（order_items）と支払い方法（checkout_drafts）を足し、商品を登録順に並べる。
 * サーバーだけで使う（画面から読まない）。単体テストが直接読むので、サーバー専用の印（server-only）は付けない。
 */
export async function loadRefundMaterials(client: SupabaseClient, orderId: string): Promise<RefundMaterials | null> {
  const { data, error } = await client.rpc('load_order_refund_materials', { _order_id: orderId });
  if (error) {
    throw new RefundStoreError('load_order_refund_materials', error);
  }
  // 表を返す関数の答えは配列。行が1つのオブジェクトで来ても読める。注文が無ければ0行
  const row = (Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : data) as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined;
  if (!row) {
    return null;
  }

  // ここから先は、呼び出し側が渡した文字ではなく、DB が返した番号（小文字）で引く
  const dbOrderId = String(row.order_id);
  const [orderResult, itemsResult] = await Promise.all([
    // DB の材料の関数は支払いの番号を返さない。宛先・氏名・メールは読まない
    client.from('orders').select('payment_intent_id').eq('id', dbOrderId).maybeSingle<{ payment_intent_id: string | null }>(),
    // 同じ注文の商品は同じ時刻に登録されるので、id を足して並びを決める
    client
      .from('order_items')
      .select('id, item_name, color, size')
      .eq('order_id', dbOrderId)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
      .order('id', { ascending: true }),
  ]);
  if (orderResult.error) {
    throw new RefundStoreError('load_order', orderResult.error);
  }
  if (itemsResult.error) {
    throw new RefundStoreError('load_order_items', itemsResult.error);
  }

  // 支払い方法（checkout_drafts に注文確定時の payment_intent_id が書き戻されている）
  const paymentIntentId = orderResult.data?.payment_intent_id ?? null;
  let draftPaymentMethod: string | null = null;
  if (paymentIntentId) {
    const draftResult = await client
      .from('checkout_drafts')
      .select('payment_method')
      .eq('payment_intent_id', paymentIntentId)
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle<{ payment_method: string }>();
    if (draftResult.error) {
      throw new RefundStoreError('load_checkout_draft', draftResult.error);
    }
    draftPaymentMethod = draftResult.data?.payment_method ?? null;
  }

  const counts = countsByItemId(row.lines);
  const lines = ((itemsResult.data ?? []) as MaterialItemRow[]).flatMap((item): RefundMaterialLine[] => {
    const line = counts.get(item.id);
    if (!line) {
      return [];
    }
    return [{
      orderItemId: item.id,
      name: item.item_name,
      color: item.color,
      size: item.size,
      fulfillmentType: line.fulfillment_type === 'backorder' ? 'backorder' : 'stock',
      itemPrice: Number(line.item_price),
      quantity: Number(line.quantity),
      lineTotal: Number(line.line_total),
      shipped: Number(line.shipped),
      unshipped: Number(line.unshipped),
      refundedBeforeShipment: Number(line.refunded_before_shipment),
      refundedAfterShipment: Number(line.refunded_after_shipment),
      shippedRefundable: Number(line.shipped_refundable),
      restockable: Number(line.restockable),
      lineDiscount: Number(line.line_discount),
      refundedUnits: Number(line.refunded_units),
    }];
  });

  // 受け取った額が空の注文（未入金）の金額は null で届く。Number(null) は 0
  return {
    order: {
      id: dbOrderId,
      orderNumber: toOrderNumber(dbOrderId),
      status: row.order_status as OrderStatus,
      paymentMethod: toPaymentMethod(draftPaymentMethod),
      totalAmount: Number(row.total_amount),
      shippingAmount: Number(row.shipping_amount),
      discountAmount: Number(row.discount_amount),
      paidAmount: Number(row.paid_amount),
      succeededAmount: Number(row.succeeded_amount),
      openAmount: Number(row.open_amount),
      refundableAmount: Number(row.refundable_amount),
      refundedShipping: Number(row.refunded_shipping),
      refundableShipping: Number(row.refundable_shipping),
      shippedTotal: Number(row.shipped_total),
      unshippedTotal: Number(row.unshipped_total),
    },
    lines,
    awaitingRefund: row.awaiting_refund_id
      ? {
          id: String(row.awaiting_refund_id),
          amount: Number(row.awaiting_refund_amount),
          createdAt: String(row.awaiting_refund_created_at),
        }
      : null,
  };
}
```

```ts
/** アプリの値と DB の enum・CHECK 制約がずれないことを、マイグレーションの本文で確かめる。 */
function migration(name: string): string {
  return fs.readFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(), 'supabase/migrations', name), 'utf8');
}

/** 本番に当てる時に版の頭の数字が付け替わる移行は、名前の後ろで探す */
function migrationEndingWith(suffix: string): string {
  const directory = path.join(process.cwd(), 'supabase/migrations');
  const files = fs.readdirSync(directory).filter((name) => name.endsWith(suffix));
  expect(files).toHaveLength(1);
  return fs.readFileSync(path.join(directory, files[0]), 'utf8');
}
```
