```ts
import type { RefundServiceDeps } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-service';
import type { ExternalRefundResultRow, RefundResultRow } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-store';
import type { StripeRefundSnapshot } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-stripe';
import {
  OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError,
  RefundSyncNotConvergedError,
  syncPaymentIntentRefunds,
} from '@/lib/stripe/order-refund-sync';

const PAYMENT_INTENT_ID = 'pi_sync_1';
const ORDER_ID = 'a1b2c3d4-1111-4222-8333-444455556666';
const OTHER_ORDER_ID = 'f1b2c3d4-1111-4222-8333-444455559999';
const OWN_REFUND_ID = 'b1b2c3d4-1111-4222-8333-444455556666';
const OTHER_REFUND_ID = 'c1b2c3d4-1111-4222-8333-444455556666';

/** Stripe の返金の写し。既定は、この注文の返金の記録（OWN_REFUND_ID）の印が付いた成功の返金 */
function snapshot(overrides: Partial<StripeRefundSnapshot> = {}): StripeRefundSnapshot {
  return {
    stripeRefundId: 're_own1',
    stripeStatus: 'succeeded',
    pendingReason: null,
    failureReason: null,
    customerActionExpiresAt: null,
    paymentMethodType: null,
    referenceNumber: null,
    referenceType: null,
    amount: 5000,
    reason: 'requested_by_customer',
    created: '2026-10-12T01:00:00.000Z',
    paymentIntentId: PAYMENT_INTENT_ID,
    metadataRefundId: OWN_REFUND_ID,
    metadataOrderId: ORDER_ID,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/** 印の無い返金（Stripe の画面からの返金など） */
function unmarked(overrides: Partial<StripeRefundSnapshot> = {}): StripeRefundSnapshot {
  return snapshot({ metadataRefundId: null, metadataOrderId: null, reason: null, ...overrides });
}

function resultRow(overrides: Partial<RefundResultRow> = {}): RefundResultRow {
  return {
    refundId: OWN_REFUND_ID,
    orderId: ORDER_ID,
    status: 'succeeded',
    newlyAccepted: true,
    newlyFailed: false,
    orderStatus: 'paid',
    refundedAmount: 5000,
    rereserveShortage: 0,
    emailEnqueued: false,
    exceptionId: null,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function externalRow(overrides: Partial<ExternalRefundResultRow> = {}): ExternalRefundResultRow {
  return {
    ...resultRow({ refundId: 'd1b2c3d4-1111-4222-8333-444455556666' }),
    created: true,
    source: 'stripe_dashboard',
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function ownRecord(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return {
    refundId: OWN_REFUND_ID,
    orderId: ORDER_ID,
    source: 'admin',
    status: 'pending',
    stripeRefundId: null,
    amount: 5000,
    paymentIntentId: PAYMENT_INTENT_ID,
    createdAt: '2026-10-12T00:59:00.000Z',
    ...overrides,
  };
}

type OrderRead = { data: { id: string; status: string } | null; error: { message: string; code?: string } | null };

function setup(order: OrderRead = { data: { id: ORDER_ID, status: 'paid' }, error: null }) {
  const maybeSingle = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(order);
  const eq = jest.fn().mockReturnValue({ maybeSingle });
  const select = jest.fn().mockReturnValue({ eq });
  const from = jest.fn().mockReturnValue({ select });
  const deps = {
    store: { from, rpc: jest.fn() },
    stripe: { name: 'stripe' },
    now: () => new Date('2026-10-12T02:00:00.000Z'),
    notifyShopOfRefundFailure: jest.fn(),
    scheduleOrderEmailDelivery: jest.fn(),
  } as unknown as RefundServiceDeps;
  return { deps, from, select, eq };
}

describe('syncPaymentIntentRefunds', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.resetAllMocks();
    mockLogAudit.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    mockApplySideEffects.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    mockListRefunds.mockResolvedValue([]);
    mockReadPaymentMethodType.mockResolvedValue('card');
  });

  it('OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError の文は今のまま', () => {
    const error = new OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError();

    expect(error.message).toBe('Order not found for Stripe PaymentIntent');
    expect(error.name).toBe('OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError');
  });

  it('支払いの番号を持つ注文が無ければ OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError を投げ、Stripe を読まない', async () => {
    const { deps, from, select, eq } = setup({ data: null, error: null });

    await expect(syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError);

    expect(from).toHaveBeenCalledWith('orders');
    expect(select).toHaveBeenCalledWith('id, status');
    expect(eq).toHaveBeenCalledWith('payment_intent_id', PAYMENT_INTENT_ID);
    expect(mockListRefunds).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('注文の読み取りが失敗したら、DB の誤りを cause に残した Error を投げる（呼ぶ側が一時的な失敗かを見分ける）', async () => {
    const dbError = { message: 'permission denied', code: '42501' };
    const { deps } = setup({ data: null, error: dbError });

    const error = await syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID).catch((caught: unknown) => caught);

    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(Error);
    expect(error).not.toBeInstanceOf(OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError);
    expect((error as Error).message).toBe('Failed to read order refund state: permission denied');
    expect((error as Error).cause).toBe(dbError);
    expect(mockListRefunds).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it.each(['payment_in_progress', 'pending', 'failed', 'abandoned'] as const)(
    '入金が決まる前の注文（%s）は skipped_unpaid。Stripe を読まず、何も書かない（R-06）',
    async (status) => {
      const { deps } = setup({ data: { id: ORDER_ID, status }, error: null });

      await expect(syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID)).resolves.toEqual({
        kind: 'skipped_unpaid',
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        orderStatus: status,
      });

      expect(mockListRefunds).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(mockRecordResult).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(mockRecordExternal).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(mockApplySideEffects).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    },
  );

  it('取り消した注文（未入金で取り消した注文を含む）の返金は飛ばさずに記録する（設計書 6-1。前は飛ばしていた）', async () => {
    const { deps } = setup({ data: { id: ORDER_ID, status: 'cancelled' }, error: null });
    const row = externalRow({ orderStatus: 'cancelled', refundedAmount: 5000 });
    mockListRefunds.mockResolvedValue([unmarked({ stripeRefundId: 're_after_cancel' })]);
    mockRecordExternal.mockResolvedValue(row);

    await expect(syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID)).resolves.toEqual({
      kind: 'synced',
      orderId: ORDER_ID,
      orderStatus: 'cancelled',
      results: [row],
    });

    expect(mockRecordExternal).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      deps.store,
      expect.objectContaining({ orderId: ORDER_ID, stripeRefundId: 're_after_cancel' }),
    );
    expect(mockApplySideEffects).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps, row);
  });

  it('印 refund_id がこの注文の記録に当たる返金は、その記録に結果を書き、後の始末を呼ぶ', async () => {
    const { deps } = setup();
    const refund = snapshot();
    const row = resultRow();
    mockListRefunds.mockResolvedValue([refund]);
    mockGetOrderRefund.mockResolvedValue(ownRecord());
    mockRecordResult.mockResolvedValue(row);

    await expect(syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID)).resolves.toEqual({
      kind: 'synced',
      orderId: ORDER_ID,
      orderStatus: 'paid',
      results: [row],
    });

    expect(mockListRefunds).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps.stripe, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID);
    expect(mockGetOrderRefund).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps.store, OWN_REFUND_ID);
    expect(mockRecordResult).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps.store, OWN_REFUND_ID, refund);
    expect(mockRecordExternal).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    // 返事を書けた記録（保留）には、頼んだ時に読んだ支払いの種類が入っている。読み直さない
    expect(mockReadPaymentMethodType).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockApplySideEffects).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockApplySideEffects).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps, row);
    expect(mockLogAudit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it.each(['awaiting_response', 'error'] as const)(
    '返事を書けていない記録（%s）に結果を書く時は、一覧の写しに支払いの種類が無ければ、Stripe から1回だけ読んで渡す',
    async (status) => {
      const { deps } = setup();
      const refund = snapshot();
      mockListRefunds.mockResolvedValue([refund]);
      mockGetOrderRefund.mockResolvedValue(ownRecord({ status }));
      mockRecordResult.mockResolvedValue(resultRow());
      mockReadPaymentMethodType.mockResolvedValue('konbini');

      await syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID);

      expect(mockReadPaymentMethodType).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(mockRecordResult).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps.store, OWN_REFUND_ID, { ...refund, paymentMethodType: 'konbini' });
    },
  );

  it('返事を書けていない記録でも、一覧の写しが支払いの種類を持っていれば、読み直さずにその種類を渡す', async () => {
    const { deps } = setup();
    const refund = snapshot({ paymentMethodType: 'paypay' });
    mockListRefunds.mockResolvedValue([refund]);
    mockGetOrderRefund.mockResolvedValue(ownRecord({ status: 'awaiting_response' }));
    mockRecordResult.mockResolvedValue(resultRow());

    await syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID);

    expect(mockReadPaymentMethodType).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockRecordResult).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps.store, OWN_REFUND_ID, refund);
  });

  it('印の無い返金は外からの返金として、古い順に記録する。支払いの種類は Stripe から1回だけ読み、注文の状態は最後の結果の物', async () => {
    const { deps } = setup();
    const older = unmarked({ stripeRefundId: 're_ext_old', amount: 3000, created: '2026-10-12T01:00:00.000Z' });
    const newer = unmarked({
      stripeRefundId: 're_ext_new',
      amount: 2000,
      created: '2026-10-12T01:30:00.000Z',
      stripeStatus: 'pending',
      pendingReason: 'processing',
    });
    // Stripe は新しい順に返す
    mockListRefunds.mockResolvedValue([newer, older]);
    const firstRow = externalRow({ orderStatus: 'paid', refundedAmount: 3000 });
    const secondRow = externalRow({ refundId: 'e1b2c3d4-1111-4222-8333-444455556666', orderStatus: 'cancelled', refundedAmount: 5000 });
    mockRecordExternal.mockResolvedValueOnce(firstRow).mockResolvedValueOnce(secondRow);

    const result = await syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID);

    expect(mockGetOrderRefund).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockReadPaymentMethodType).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockReadPaymentMethodType).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps.stripe, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID);
    expect(mockRecordExternal).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(mockRecordExternal).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, deps.store, {
      orderId: ORDER_ID,
      amount: 3000,
      stripeReason: null,
      stripeCreatedAt: '2026-10-12T01:00:00.000Z',
      stripeRefundId: 're_ext_old',
      stripeStatus: 'succeeded',
      pendingReason: null,
      failureReason: null,
      customerActionExpiresAt: null,
      paymentMethodType: 'card',
      referenceNumber: null,
      referenceType: null,
    });
    expect(mockRecordExternal).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(
      2,
      deps.store,
      expect.objectContaining({
        amount: 2000,
        stripeRefundId: 're_ext_new',
        stripeStatus: 'pending',
        pendingReason: 'processing',
        paymentMethodType: 'card',
      }),
    );
    expect(result).toEqual({ kind: 'synced', orderId: ORDER_ID, orderStatus: 'cancelled', results: [firstRow, secondRow] });
    expect(mockApplySideEffects).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, deps, firstRow);
    expect(mockApplySideEffects).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, deps, secondRow);
  });

  it('外からの返金でも、一覧の写しが支払いの種類を持っていれば、読み直さずにその種類を渡す', async () => {
    const { deps } = setup();
    mockListRefunds.mockResolvedValue([unmarked({ stripeRefundId: 're_ext_paypay', paymentMethodType: 'paypay' })]);
    mockRecordExternal.mockResolvedValue(externalRow());

    await syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID);

    expect(mockReadPaymentMethodType).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockRecordExternal).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps.store, expect.objectContaining({ paymentMethodType: 'paypay' }));
  });

  it('他の注文の印の返金は、外からの返金として記録し、監査に残す（Stripe の返金の番号と印だけ）', async () => {

    mockListRefunds.mockResolvedValue([snapshot({ stripeRefundId: 're_other', metadataRefundId: OTHER_REFUND_ID })]);
    mockGetOrderRefund.mockResolvedValue(ownRecord({ refundId: OTHER_REFUND_ID, orderId: OTHER_ORDER_ID }));
    mockRecordExternal.mockResolvedValue(externalRow());

    expect(mockGetOrderRefund).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps.store, OTHER_REFUND_ID);
    expect(mockRecordResult).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockRecordExternal).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps.store, expect.objectContaining({ orderId: ORDER_ID, stripeRefundId: 're_other' }));
    expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

        metadata: { stripe_refund_id: 're_other', marker_refund_id: OTHER_REFUND_ID },

  it.each([

  it('印の合わない返金でも、すでに記録してあった返金（created が false）を合わせ直す時は、監査を残さない（同じ支払いの同期は何度も走る）', async () => {
    const { deps } = setup();
    mockListRefunds.mockResolvedValue([snapshot({ stripeRefundId: 're_again', metadataRefundId: OTHER_REFUND_ID })]);

  it('返金が1件も無ければ、何も書かず、注文の状態をそのまま返す', async () => {
    const { deps } = setup({ data: { id: ORDER_ID, status: 'shipped' }, error: null });

    await expect(syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID)).resolves.toEqual({

      results: [],
    });

    expect(mockRecordResult).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockRecordExternal).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockApplySideEffects).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

  it('切り替えより前の返金（Review Focus 5）: 古さは DB の関数が決める。作った時刻をそのまま渡し、写し legacy の答えをそのまま返す', async () => {
    const { deps } = setup();
    mockListRefunds.mockResolvedValue([unmarked({ stripeRefundId: 're_old_test', created: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z' })]);
    const legacy = externalRow({ source: 'legacy', newlyAccepted: false, emailEnqueued: false });
    mockRecordExternal.mockResolvedValue(legacy);

    const result = await syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID);

    expect(mockRecordExternal).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps.store, expect.objectContaining({ stripeCreatedAt: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z' }));
    expect(result).toEqual({ kind: 'synced', orderId: ORDER_ID, orderStatus: 'paid', results: [legacy] });
    // 写しは在庫もメールも動かさない。後の始末には、動かさなかった答えがそのまま渡る
    expect(mockApplySideEffects).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps, legacy);
  });

  it('一部を発送した注文の外からの全額の返金（Review Focus 4）: キャンセルとメールの予定の答えを、後の始末にそのまま渡す', async () => {
    const { deps } = setup({ data: { id: ORDER_ID, status: 'paid' }, error: null });
    mockListRefunds.mockResolvedValue([unmarked({ stripeRefundId: 're_full', amount: 10_000 })]);
    // DB の関数が、未発送の商品を全部この返金の発送前の行に入れて在庫に戻し、注文をキャンセルにした答え
    const cancelled = externalRow({
      created: true,
      source: 'stripe_dashboard',
      status: 'succeeded',
      newlyAccepted: true,
      orderStatus: 'cancelled',
      refundedAmount: 10_000,

    mockRecordExternal.mockResolvedValue(cancelled);

    const result = await syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID);

    expect(result).toEqual({ kind: 'synced', orderId: ORDER_ID, orderStatus: 'cancelled', results: [cancelled] });
    expect(mockApplySideEffects).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockApplySideEffects).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps, cancelled);

  it('書いた後に返金の状態が変わっていたら、読み直した一覧で書き直す', async () => {
    const { deps } = setup();
    const pending = snapshot({ stripeStatus: 'pending', pendingReason: 'processing' });
    const succeeded = snapshot();
    mockListRefunds
      .mockResolvedValueOnce([pending])
      .mockResolvedValueOnce([succeeded])
      .mockResolvedValueOnce([succeeded]);
    mockGetOrderRefund.mockResolvedValue(ownRecord());
    mockRecordResult
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(resultRow({ status: 'pending' }))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(resultRow({ status: 'succeeded' }));

    const result = await syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID);

    // 最初の一覧・書いた後の読み直し・書き直した後の読み直し
    expect(mockListRefunds).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
    expect(mockRecordResult).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(mockRecordResult).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, deps.store, OWN_REFUND_ID, pending);
    expect(mockRecordResult).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, deps.store, OWN_REFUND_ID, succeeded);
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'synced', results: [expect.objectContaining({ status: 'succeeded' })] });
    expect(mockApplySideEffects).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);

  it('3回書いても返金が変わり続けたら RefundSyncNotConvergedError。書くのは3回まで', async () => {
    const { deps } = setup();
    let reads = 0;
    mockListRefunds.mockImplementation(async () => {

    });
    mockRecordExternal.mockResolvedValue(externalRow());

    await expect(syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(RefundSyncNotConvergedError);

    // 最初の一覧 + 書くたびの読み直し3回
    expect(mockListRefunds).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(4);
    expect(mockRecordExternal).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
  });

  it('結果を書く DB の呼び出しが失敗したら、そのまま投げる（知らせの再試行に任せる）。後の始末は呼ばない', async () => {
    const { deps } = setup();
    const failure = new Error('refund store failed: record_order_refund_result');
    mockListRefunds.mockResolvedValue([snapshot()]);
    mockGetOrderRefund.mockResolvedValue(ownRecord());
    mockRecordResult.mockRejectedValue(failure);

    await expect(syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID)).rejects.toBe(failure);

    expect(mockApplySideEffects).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('Stripe の読み取りの失敗はそのまま投げる（照合が一時的な失敗かを見分ける）', async () => {
    const { deps } = setup();
    const stripeError = { type: 'StripeConnectionError' };
    mockListRefunds.mockRejectedValue(stripeError);

    await expect(syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, PAYMENT_INTENT_ID)).rejects.toBe(stripeError);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 取り込みを作り直す**

`src/lib/stripe/order-refund-sync.ts`（前の中身を全部、次に置き換える）:

```ts
import { logAudit } from '@/lib/audit';
import type { OrderStatus } from '@/lib/orders/order-payment-types';
import { applyRefundSideEffects, type RefundServiceDeps } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-service';
import {
  getOrderRefund,
  recordExternalOrderRefund,
  recordOrderRefundResult,
  type RefundResultRow,
} from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-store';
import {
  listPaymentIntentRefunds,
  readPaymentMethodType,
  type StripeRefundSnapshot,
} from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-stripe';

/**
 * 支払いの番号から、その支払いの Stripe の返金を全部読み直し、1件ずつ返金の記録に合わせる（グループ E-2 設計書 6-1）。
 * Stripe の知らせ・毎時の見回り・毎晩の照合・決済の照合が、同じものを呼ぶ。何度呼んでも同じ結果に収まる。
 * 知らせは順番どおりに届かず重なるので、知らせの中身は使わず、読み直した現在値だけで合わせる。
 */

/**
 * 支払いの番号を持つ注文が無い（注文を作れなかった支払いなど）。再試行しても直らないので、呼ぶ側が見分けて飛ばす。
 * Error のままで、文は変えない。
 */
export class OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError extends Error {
  constructor() {
    super('Order not found for Stripe PaymentIntent');
    this.name = 'OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError';
  }
}

/** 3回続けて、書いている間に Stripe の返金が変わった。読み直せば収まるので、呼ぶ側は一時的な失敗として扱える */
export class RefundSyncNotConvergedError extends Error {
  constructor() {
    super('Stripe refunds kept changing while they were synced to the order');
    this.name = 'RefundSyncNotConvergedError';
  }
}

export type RefundSyncResult =
  | { kind: 'synced'; orderId: string; orderStatus: OrderStatus; results: RefundResultRow[] }
  | { kind: 'skipped_unpaid'; orderId: string; orderStatus: OrderStatus };

/** 書いた後に Stripe を読み直して、返金が変わっていた時にやり直す回数の上限 */
const MAX_SYNC_ATTEMPTS = 3;

/** 入金が決まる前の注文。返金は記録せず、入金が決まった後の決済の照合と毎晩の照合が合わせる（R-06） */
const UNPAID_STATUSES: ReadonlySet<OrderStatus> = new Set<OrderStatus>([
  'payment_in_progress',
  'pending',
  'failed',
  'abandoned',
]);

/** 印 refund_id は uuid の列に渡すので、形を確かめてから使う（形が違うと DB が 22P02 で止まり、その返金の同期が永遠に失敗する） */
const UUID_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

type SyncOrderRow = { id: string; status: OrderStatus };

async function readOrder(deps: RefundServiceDeps, paymentIntentId: string): Promise<SyncOrderRow> {
  const { data, error } = await deps.store
    .from('orders')
    .select('id, status')
    .eq('payment_intent_id', paymentIntentId)
    .maybeSingle<SyncOrderRow>();

  if (error) {
    // DB の誤りを cause に残し、呼ぶ側が一時的な失敗（接続・直列化）かを見分けられるようにする
    throw new Error(`Failed to read order refund state: ${error.message ?? 'database error'}`, { cause: error });
  }
  if (!data) {
    throw new OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError();
  }
  return data;
}

/** 作った時刻の古い順（同じ時刻は番号順）。全額に届く返金が、未発送の商品を引き受ける順を、実際の順にそろえる */
function oldestFirst(refunds: readonly StripeRefundSnapshot[]): StripeRefundSnapshot[] {
  return [...refunds].sort(
    (a, b) => Date.parse(a.created) - Date.parse(b.created) || a.stripeRefundId.localeCompare(b.stripeRefundId),
  );
}

/** 返金の番号と状態の組。書いている間に変わったかを見る */
function refundKey(refunds: readonly StripeRefundSnapshot[]): string {
  return refunds
    .map((refund) => `${refund.stripeRefundId}:${refund.stripeStatus}`)
    .sort()
    .join(',');
}

/** 印はあるが、この注文の記録に当たらない返金。Stripe の返金の番号と印だけを監査に残す（個人情報は入れない） */
async function auditUnmatchedMarker(orderId: string, refund: StripeRefundSnapshot): Promise<void> {
  await logAudit({
    action: 'stripe.refund.marker_unmatched',
    resource: 'orders',
    resource_id: orderId,
    outcome: 'conflict',
    detail: 'Refund carries a refund_id marker that does not match a refund record of the order',
    metadata: { stripe_refund_id: refund.stripeRefundId, marker_refund_id: refund.metadataRefundId },
  });
}

/** 一覧の写しの支払いの種類は null（Task 5 の一覧は支払いを読まない）。要る時に、Stripe から読んで添える（写しが持っていれば、そのまま使う） */
async function withPaymentMethod(
  refund: StripeRefundSnapshot,
  readPaymentMethod: () => Promise<string | null>,
): Promise<StripeRefundSnapshot> {
  return refund.paymentMethodType === null ? { ...refund, paymentMethodType: await readPaymentMethod() } : refund;
}

async function writeRefund(
  deps: RefundServiceDeps,
  order: SyncOrderRow,
  refund: StripeRefundSnapshot,
  readPaymentMethod: () => Promise<string | null>,
): Promise<RefundResultRow> {
  const marker = refund.metadataRefundId;
  if (marker && UUID_PATTERN.test(marker)) {
    const own = await getOrderRefund(deps.store, marker);
    if (own && own.orderId === order.id) {
      // 返事待ち・エラーの記録は、頼んだ時の返事を書けなかった物なので、支払いの種類がまだ無い。写しに無ければ Stripe から読んで渡す
      // （コンビニ払いの返金のメールの文と画面の期限が、これで決まる）。返事を書けた記録には、書いた種類が入っている
      const lacksPaymentMethod = own.status === 'awaiting_response' || own.status === 'error';
      return recordOrderRefundResult(
        deps.store,
        own.refundId,
        lacksPaymentMethod ? await withPaymentMethod(refund, readPaymentMethod) : refund,
      );
    }
  }

  // 外からの返金。切り替えより前の物を写しにするかは、DB の関数が作った時刻で決める
  const external = await withPaymentMethod(refund, readPaymentMethod);
  const result = await recordExternalOrderRefund(deps.store, {
    orderId: order.id,
    amount: external.amount,
    stripeReason: external.reason,
    stripeCreatedAt: external.created,
    stripeRefundId: external.stripeRefundId,
    stripeStatus: external.stripeStatus,
    pendingReason: external.pendingReason,
    failureReason: external.failureReason,
    customerActionExpiresAt: external.customerActionExpiresAt,
    paymentMethodType: external.paymentMethodType,
    referenceNumber: external.referenceNumber,
    referenceType: external.referenceType,
  });
  // 印はあるのにこの注文の記録に当たらない返金の監査は、記録を作った時の1回だけ残す（同じ支払いの同期は何度も走る）
  if (marker && result.created) {
    await auditUnmatchedMarker(order.id, refund);
  }
  return result;
}

export async function syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps: RefundServiceDeps, paymentIntentId: string): Promise<RefundSyncResult> {
  const order = await readOrder(deps, paymentIntentId);
  if (UNPAID_STATUSES.has(order.status)) {
    return { kind: 'skipped_unpaid', orderId: order.id, orderStatus: order.status };
  }

  // 支払いの種類が要る時だけ、Stripe の支払いから読む。1回の同期で1回
  let paymentMethodType: Promise<string | null> | null = null;
  const readPaymentMethod = () => (paymentMethodType ??= readPaymentMethodType(deps.stripe, paymentIntentId));

  let refunds = await listPaymentIntentRefunds(deps.stripe, paymentIntentId);
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= MAX_SYNC_ATTEMPTS; attempt += 1) {
    const results: RefundResultRow[] = [];
    for (const refund of oldestFirst(refunds)) {
      const result = await writeRefund(deps, order, refund, readPaymentMethod);
      results.push(result);
      // 後の始末は例外を投げない（記録はもう書けているので、落ちても結果を変えない。Task 5 の決め事）
      await applyRefundSideEffects(deps, result);
    }

    // 書いている間に、後から届いた知らせの分だけ Stripe が変わることがある。読み直して、古い一覧が最後に勝たないようにする
    const confirmed = await listPaymentIntentRefunds(deps.stripe, paymentIntentId);
    if (refundKey(confirmed) === refundKey(refunds)) {
      return {
        kind: 'synced',
        orderId: order.id,
        orderStatus: results.length > 0 ? results[results.length - 1].orderStatus : order.status,
        results,
      };
    }
    refunds = confirmed;
  }

  throw new RefundSyncNotConvergedError();
}
```

```ts
import { OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError } from '@/lib/stripe/order-refund-sync';
import { processStripeWebhookEvent } from '@/lib/stripe/webhook-processor';

async function processForTest(req: NextRequest): Promise<{ status: number; body: Record<string, unknown> }> {
  const event = await req.json() as Parameters<typeof processStripeWebhookEvent>[0];
  try {
    await processStripeWebhookEvent(event, req);
    return { status: 200, body: { processed: true } };
  } catch {
    return { status: 500, body: { error: 'Processing failed' } };
  }
}

function makeRequest(payload: unknown, signature = 'stripe-signature'): NextRequest {
  const req = new NextRequest('http://localhost/api/webhook/stripe', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'stripe-signature': signature },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
  return req;
}
```

(2) 88〜153 行目（`handleRefundChanged` の説明のコメントと関数の全体。前）を、次に置き換える:

```ts
/**
 * 返金の変化を注文へ反映する。知らせは合図にだけ使い、その支払いの返金を Stripe から読み直して返金の記録に合わせる
 * （order-refund-sync.ts。グループ E-2 設計書 6-1）。やり直しても直らない知らせは、失敗にして永久に再試行させず、
 * ID だけを監査に残して完了にする（後段の会計の同期は呼び出し側が続ける。R-06）。
 *
 * - 支払いの番号が無い返金は、読み直す相手が無い
 * - 入金が決まる前の注文（支払い手続き中・未入金・失敗・放棄）の返金は、入金が決まった後に決済の照合と毎晩の照合が合わせる
 * - 注文に結び付いていない支払いの返金（注文を作れず要対応になった支払いを、店が Stripe で返金したとき）は、
 *   注文が現れないので再試行しても直らない。
 *   ただし、その返金が失敗・取消で終わったときは、支払いだけが残り、照合も二度とこの支払いを見ないので、
 *   飛ばさずに要対応として記録し、店へ知らせる（既存の要対応の仕組み。同じ返金のイベントが何度届いても1件・1通）。
 * 取り込みや要対応の記録に失敗したときは握りつぶさず投げる（worker がイベントを失敗にして再試行する）。
 */
async function handleRefundChanged(
  event: Stripe.Event,
  object: Stripe.Refund | Stripe.Charge,
  auditRequest: NextRequest,
): Promise<void> {
  const paymentIntentId = resolvePaymentIntentId(object.payment_intent);
  const isCharge = event.type === 'charge.refunded';
  const identifiers = {
    event_id: event.id,
    event_type: event.type,
    payment_intent_id: paymentIntentId,
    refund_id: isCharge ? null : object.id,
    charge_id: isCharge ? object.id : null,
  };

  if (!paymentIntentId) {
    await logWebhookAudit(
      auditRequest,
      'checkout.webhook.refund_without_payment_intent',
      'success',
      'Refund event skipped: no payment_intent',
      identifiers,
    );
    return;
  }

  try {
    const synced = await syncPaymentIntentRefunds(await createDefaultRefundServiceDeps(), paymentIntentId);
    if (synced.kind === 'skipped_unpaid') {
      await logWebhookAudit(
        auditRequest,
        'checkout.webhook.refund_on_unpaid_order',
        'success',
        'Refund event skipped: the order is not paid yet',
        { ...identifiers, order_id: synced.orderId, order_status: synced.orderStatus },
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError)) {
      throw error;
    }

    const failedStatus = failedRefundStatusOf(event, object);
    if (!failedStatus) {
      await logWebhookAudit(
        auditRequest,
        'checkout.webhook.refund_without_order',
        'success',
        'Refund event skipped: no order for the PaymentIntent',
        identifiers,
      );
      return;
    }

    const exception = await raiseRefundFailureWithoutOrder(await createDefaultReconcilerDeps(), {
      paymentIntentId,
      refundId: object.id,
      refundStatus: failedStatus,
    });
    await logWebhookAudit(
      auditRequest,
      'checkout.webhook.refund_without_order',
      'error',
      'Refund failed or canceled without an order: payment exception recorded',
      { ...identifiers, refund_status: failedStatus, exception_id: exception.exceptionId },
    );
  }
}
```

```ts
describe('createReconcilerRefundSync', () => {
  /**
   * 照合が呼ぶ返金の同期（order-refund-sync.ts の syncPaymentIntentRefunds）。同期そのものは order-refund-sync.test.ts が確かめる。
   * ここでは、同期した後の注文の状態を返すことと、一時的な失敗（Stripe の通信・5xx・回数制限、DB の接続・直列化など）を
   * 照合の一時的な失敗にして投げ直し（呼び出し元が再試行する）、恒久的な失敗は元のエラーのまま投げることを確かめる。
   */
  const refundDeps = { name: 'refund-service-deps' } as unknown as RefundServiceDeps;
  const sync = createReconcilerRefundSync(refundDeps);

  beforeEach(() => {
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds.mockReset();
  });

  it('PaymentIntent の返金を取り込み、取り込んだ後の注文の状態を返す', async () => {
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds.mockResolvedValue({ kind: 'synced', orderId: 'order-1', orderStatus: 'paid', results: [] });

    await expect(sync('pi_1')).resolves.toBe('paid');

    expect(mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds).toHaveBeenCalledWith(refundDeps, 'pi_1');
  });

  it('全額返金を取り込んで注文が取消になったら、取消を返す', async () => {
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds.mockResolvedValue({ kind: 'synced', orderId: 'order-1', orderStatus: 'cancelled', results: [] });

    await expect(sync('pi_1')).resolves.toBe('cancelled');
  });

  it('入金が決まる前の注文（skipped_unpaid）は、その状態を返す', async () => {
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds.mockResolvedValue({ kind: 'skipped_unpaid', orderId: 'order-1', orderStatus: 'pending' });

    await expect(sync('pi_1')).resolves.toBe('pending');
  });

  it('書いている間に返金が変わり続けて収まらない（RefundSyncNotConvergedError）失敗は、照合の一時的な失敗（not_converged）にする', async () => {
    // 同時の更新や Stripe の返金の変化は、読み直せば収まる。恒久的なエラーとして永久に失敗させない
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds.mockRejectedValue(new RefundSyncNotConvergedError());

    await expect(sync('pi_1')).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'ReconcileTransientError', code: 'not_converged' });
  });

  it.each([
    ['通信の失敗', { type: 'StripeConnectionError' }],
    ['Stripe の障害', { type: 'StripeAPIError', statusCode: 500 }],
    ['回数制限', { type: 'StripeRateLimitError', statusCode: 429 }],
  ])('Stripe の一時的な失敗（%s）は、照合の一時的な失敗（stripe_unavailable）にする', async (_name, stripeError) => {
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds.mockRejectedValue(stripeError);

    await expect(sync('pi_1')).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'ReconcileTransientError', code: 'stripe_unavailable' });
  });

  it('Stripe の恒久的なエラー（入力の誤りなど）は、元のエラーのまま投げる', async () => {
    const stripeError = { type: 'StripeInvalidRequestError', statusCode: 400 };
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds.mockRejectedValue(stripeError);

    await expect(sync('pi_1')).rejects.toBe(stripeError);
  });

  it.each([
    ['code の無い（通信の失敗）', { message: 'timeout' }],
    ['接続の失敗（08006）', { message: 'connection failure', code: '08006' }],
    ['直列化の失敗（40001）', { message: 'could not serialize access', code: '40001' }],
  ])('DB の一時的な失敗（%s）は、照合の一時的な失敗（db_unavailable）にする', async (_name, dbError) => {
    // 取り込みは DB の失敗を message だけの Error にして投げ、元のエラー（code 付き）を cause に残す
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds.mockRejectedValue(new Error('refund store failed: record_order_refund_result', { cause: dbError }));

    await expect(sync('pi_1')).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: 'ReconcileTransientError', code: 'db_unavailable' });
  });

  it.each([
    ['注文の読み取り', { message: 'permission denied', code: '42501' }, 'Failed to read order refund state: permission denied'],
    ['返金の記録の書き込み', { message: 'check constraint violated', code: '23514' }, 'refund store failed: record_order_refund_result'],
  ])('%sの恒久的なエラーは、一時的な失敗にせず、同じ内容のエラーのまま投げる', async (_name, dbError, message) => {
    const failure = new Error(message, { cause: dbError });
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds.mockRejectedValue(failure);

    await expect(sync('pi_1')).rejects.toBe(failure);
  });

  it('原因を持たない失敗（cause が null）は、一時的な失敗にしない', async () => {
    const failure = new Error('refund store failed: record_order_refund_result', { cause: null });
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds.mockRejectedValue(failure);

    await expect(sync('pi_1')).rejects.toBe(failure);
  });

  it('PaymentIntent に注文が無ければ、その型のエラーのまま投げる（一時的な失敗にしない）', async () => {
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds.mockRejectedValue(new OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError());

    await expect(sync('pi_1')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError);
  });
});
```

(2) 288〜343 行目（`toReconcileError` から `createDefaultReconcilerDeps` の終わりまで。前）を、次に置き換える:

```ts
/** 返金の同期の失敗を、一時的なら ReconcileTransientError に、そうでなければ元のエラーのままにする */
function toReconcileError(error: unknown): unknown {
  if (isTransientStripeError(error)) {
    return new ReconcileTransientError('stripe_unavailable', { cause: error });
  }

  // 同時の更新や Stripe の返金の変化に負け続けただけで、読み直せば収まる
  if (error instanceof RefundSyncNotConvergedError) {
    return new ReconcileTransientError('not_converged', { cause: error });
  }

  // 返金の同期は DB の失敗を message だけの Error にして投げ、元のエラー（code 付き）を cause に残す。
  // cause の無い失敗（DB の窓口が思いがけず返した空の答えなど）は、再試行しても直らないので一時的にしない
  const cause = error instanceof Error ? error.cause : undefined;
  if (cause && isTransientSupabaseError(cause)) {
    return new ReconcileTransientError('db_unavailable', { cause: error });
  }

  return error;
}

/**
 * 照合が呼ぶ返金の同期（order-refund-sync.ts の syncPaymentIntentRefunds）。同期したあとの注文の状態を返す
 * （入金が決まる前の注文を飛ばした時も、その状態）。
 * 一時的な失敗（Stripe の通信・5xx・回数制限、DB の接続・直列化、競合で収まらない）は ReconcileTransientError にして
 * 投げ（呼び出し元が再試行する）、それ以外は元のエラーのまま投げる。
 */
export function createReconcilerRefundSync(refund: RefundServiceDeps): ReconcilerDeps['syncRefunds'] {
  return async (paymentIntentId) => {
    try {
      const synced = await syncPaymentIntentRefunds(refund, paymentIntentId);
      return synced.orderStatus;
    } catch (error) {
      throw toReconcileError(error);
    }
  };
}

export async function createDefaultReconcilerDeps(): Promise<ReconcilerDeps> {
  const client = await createServiceRoleClient();
  const stripeClient = getStripeServerClient();
  const stripe = stripeClient as unknown as CheckoutPaymentStripeClient;
  // 返金の部品（Stripe・DB の client・店への知らせ）。返金の同期はこれで動く。
  // createDefaultRefundServiceDeps は、この関数ではなく createSupabaseReconcilerDatabase・createReconcilerMailer を直に使う。
  // この関数を呼び返すと、互いに呼び合って終わらない
  const refund = await createDefaultRefundServiceDeps();

  return {
    readPayment: (ref) => readCheckoutPayment(stripe, ref),
    database: createSupabaseReconcilerDatabase(client),
    mailer: createReconcilerMailer(),
    audit: reconcileAudit,
    syncRefunds: createReconcilerRefundSync(refund),
    now: () => new Date(),
  };
}
```

`createDefaultRefundServiceDeps`（`refund-service.ts`。Task 5）は、店への知らせのために、このファイルの `createSupabaseReconcilerDatabase`・`createReconcilerMailer` を関数の中の `import()` で読む（静的に import すると、このファイルが `refund-service.ts` を import しているので、互いを import する輪ができる。Task 5 の決め事）。だから、このファイルは `refund-service.ts` を静的に import してよい。一方、`createDefaultRefundServiceDeps` が `createDefaultReconcilerDeps` を呼ぶ作りになっていると、上の関数と互いに呼び合って終わらない。Task 5 の作りが違っていたら、先に直す。

```ts
function awaiting(index: number, overrides: { paymentIntentId?: string | null } = {}) {

    metadataRefundId: record.refundId,
    metadataOrderId: record.orderId,
    ...overrides,
  };
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: 返事待ちの返金の見回りを書く**

`src/lib/orders/refund/refund-sweep.ts`（新規）:

```ts
import type { ShopPaymentAlert } from '@/lib/orders/order-lifecycle-emails';
import { REFUND_FAILURE_REASON_LABELS } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-messages';
import { applyRefundSideEffects, type RefundServiceDeps } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-service';
import {
  listAwaitingOrderRefunds,
  markOrderRefundError,
  recordOrderRefundResult,
} from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-store';
import {
  listPaymentIntentRefunds,
  readPaymentMethodType,
  type StripeRefundSnapshot,
} from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-stripe';
import { webhookFailureCause } from '@/lib/stripe/webhook-events';

/**
 * 返事待ちの返金の見回り（グループ E-2 設計書 6-2）。毎時の見回りの最後に動く。
 * 返金は、記録（返事待ち）を先に作ってから Stripe に頼む。頼んだ後に返事を書けなかった記録（通信が切れた・アプリが落ちた）は
 * 返事待ちのまま残るので、その支払いの返金の一覧から印 refund_id で探す。見つかれば結果を書き、
 * 見つからなければ（Stripe に届かなかった）エラーにして、要対応「返金の失敗」を作り、店へ知らせる。
 * 頼んだばかりの記録は、まだ頼んでいる最中かもしれない。呼ぶ側が olderThan（15分前）で切る。
 */
export type AwaitingRefundSweepReport = {
  checked: number;
  synced: number;
  errored: number;
  failures: number;
  timeBudgetExhausted: boolean;
};

type AwaitingRefund = { refundId: string; orderId: string; paymentIntentId: string | null; createdAt: string };
type SettleOutcome = 'synced' | 'errored' | 'unchanged';

/** Stripe に見つからなかった記録のエラーの理由（返金の記録の stripe_failure_reason） */
const NOT_FOUND_REASON = 'not_found_in_stripe';

/** 要対応「返金の失敗」の店への知らせ。Stripe の返金の番号がまだ無いので、要対応の参照は返金の記録の番号 */
function notFoundAlert(deps: RefundServiceDeps, record: AwaitingRefund): ShopPaymentAlert {
  return {
    reason: 'refund_failed',
    detail: NOT_FOUND_REASON,
    orderId: record.orderId,
    paymentRef: record.refundId,
    detectedAt: deps.now(),
    refundFailure: {
      failureReasonLabel: REFUND_FAILURE_REASON_LABELS.not_found_in_stripe,
      // 返事待ちの間は在庫を動かしていないので、確保し直せなかった商品は無い
      shortages: [],
      // キャンセルのお知らせは、Stripe が受け付けた時に書く。受け付けていないので、まだ送っていない
      cancelEmailSent: false,
    },
  };
}

/** Stripe がその支払いを知らない（何度読んでも見つからない）。見つからなかった返金と同じにエラーにする */
function isUnknownToStripe(error: unknown): boolean {
  const failure = (typeof error === 'object' && error !== null ? error : {}) as { type?: unknown; code?: unknown };
  return failure.type === 'StripeInvalidRequestError' && failure.code === 'resource_missing';
}

/** その支払いの返金の一覧から、印 refund_id が記録の番号に当たる返金を探す。支払いそのものを Stripe が知らなければ、見つからなかったのと同じ（null） */
async function findInStripe(
  deps: RefundServiceDeps,
  paymentIntentId: string,
  refundId: string,
): Promise<StripeRefundSnapshot | null> {
  try {
    const refunds = await listPaymentIntentRefunds(deps.stripe, paymentIntentId);
    return refunds.find((refund) => refund.metadataRefundId === refundId) ?? null;
  } catch (error) {
    if (isUnknownToStripe(error)) return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

async function settleOne(deps: RefundServiceDeps, record: AwaitingRefund): Promise<SettleOutcome> {
  if (record.paymentIntentId) {
    const found = await findInStripe(deps, record.paymentIntentId, record.refundId);
    if (found) {
      // 頼んだ時の返事を書けなかったので、記録には支払いの種類がまだ無い。一覧の写しの種類は null なので、Stripe から読んで渡す
      const paymentMethodType = found.paymentMethodType ?? (await readPaymentMethodType(deps.stripe, record.paymentIntentId));
      const result = await recordOrderRefundResult(deps.store, record.refundId, { ...found, paymentMethodType });
      // 後の始末は例外を投げない（記録はもう書けているので、落ちても結果を変えない。Task 5 の決め事）
      await applyRefundSideEffects(deps, result);
      return 'synced';
    }
  }

  // Stripe に届かなかった（支払いの番号が無い注文の記録も、Stripe に頼めなかったのでここ）。エラーにして要対応を作る
  const marked = await markOrderRefundError(deps.store, record.refundId, NOT_FOUND_REASON, true);
  if (marked.outcome !== 'errored') {
    // 見回りの間に、知らせか確かめ直しが先に片付けた
    return 'unchanged';
  }
  if (marked.exceptionId) {
    try {
      await deps.notifyShopOfRefundFailure(marked.exceptionId, notFoundAlert(deps, record));
    } catch (error) {
      // エラーにした記録は書けている。知らせが送れなくても、店への知らせは毎時の見回りが未送信の要対応として送り直す
      console.error('[refund-sweep] failed to notify the shop', webhookFailureCause(error));
    }
  }
  return 'errored';
}

export async function sweepAwaitingRefunds(
  deps: RefundServiceDeps,
  options: { olderThan: Date; limit: number; deadline: number },
): Promise<AwaitingRefundSweepReport> {
  const report: AwaitingRefundSweepReport = { checked: 0, synced: 0, errored: 0, failures: 0, timeBudgetExhausted: false };

  for (const record of await listAwaitingOrderRefunds(deps.store, options.olderThan, options.limit)) {
    if (deps.now().getTime() >= options.deadline) {
      report.timeBudgetExhausted = true;
      break;
    }

    report.checked += 1;
    try {
      const outcome = await settleOne(deps, record);
      if (outcome === 'synced') report.synced += 1;
      if (outcome === 'errored') report.errored += 1;
    } catch (error) {
      // 1件の失敗で残りを止めない。記録は返事待ちのまま残り、次の回に確かめ直す
      report.failures += 1;
      console.error('[refund-sweep] failed to settle an awaiting refund', record.refundId, webhookFailureCause(error));
    }
  }

  return report;
}
```

```ts
describe('reconcileStripeOrders: unmatchedRecentPayments（直近7日の、注文の無い成功の支払い）', () => {

  function stripeWith(payments: Payment[], refunded: Record<string, number> = {}) {
    return {
      paymentIntents: { list: () => payments },
      refunds: {
        list: ({ payment_intent }: { payment_intent: string }) => (
          refunded[payment_intent] ? [{ status: 'succeeded', amount: refunded[payment_intent], created: 1 }] : []
        ),
      },
    };

  it('ちょうど7日前の支払いは載せ、それより1秒古い支払いは載せない（注文の無い支払い全体の数は変えない）', async () => {
    const stripe = stripeWith([
      { id: 'pi_new', status: 'succeeded', amount: 8900, currency: 'jpy', created: NOW_SECONDS - 3600 },
      { id: 'pi_edge', status: 'succeeded', amount: 1200, currency: 'jpy', created: NOW_SECONDS - 7 * DAY_SECONDS },
      { id: 'pi_old', status: 'succeeded', amount: 3000, currency: 'jpy', created: NOW_SECONDS - 7 * DAY_SECONDS - 1 },
    ]);

    const report = await reconcileStripeOrders({ database: noOrders, stripe, now: () => NOW });

    expect(report.unmatchedActivePayments).toEqual(['pi_new', 'pi_edge', 'pi_old']);
    expect(report.unmatchedRecentPayments).toEqual([
      { id: 'pi_new', amount: 8900, currency: 'jpy', created: NOW_SECONDS - 3600 },
      { id: 'pi_edge', amount: 1200, currency: 'jpy', created: NOW_SECONDS - 7 * DAY_SECONDS },
    ]);
  });

  it('全額返金済み・注文のある支払い・成功していない支払いは載せない。一部だけ返金した支払いは載せる', async () => {
    const database = {
      from: () => ({ select: async () => ({ data: [{ payment_intent_id: 'pi_with_order' }], error: null }) }),
    };
    const stripe = stripeWith(
      [
        { id: 'pi_fully_refunded', status: 'succeeded', amount: 2000, ...PAYMENT },
        { id: 'pi_partly_refunded', status: 'succeeded', amount: 5000, ...PAYMENT },
        { id: 'pi_with_order', status: 'succeeded', amount: 1000, ...PAYMENT },
        { id: 'pi_not_paid', status: 'requires_payment_method', amount: 1000, ...PAYMENT },
      ],
      { pi_fully_refunded: 2000, pi_partly_refunded: 2000 },
    );

    const report = await reconcileStripeOrders({ database, stripe, now: () => NOW });

    expect(report.unmatchedActivePayments).toEqual(['pi_partly_refunded']);
    expect(report.unmatchedRecentPayments.map((payment) => payment.id)).toEqual(['pi_partly_refunded']);
  });

  it('時計を渡さないときは、今の時刻から7日を数える', async () => {
    const nowSeconds = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    const stripe = stripeWith([
      { id: 'pi_recent', status: 'succeeded', amount: 1000, currency: 'jpy', created: nowSeconds - 60 },
      { id: 'pi_eight_days', status: 'succeeded', amount: 1000, currency: 'jpy', created: nowSeconds - 8 * DAY_SECONDS },
    ]);

    const report = await reconcileStripeOrders({ database: noOrders, stripe });

    expect(report.unmatchedRecentPayments.map((payment) => payment.id)).toEqual(['pi_recent']);
  });
});

describe('reconcileRecentRefunds（前の48時間の返金と、保留の返金の支払いを、取り込みに通す）', () => {
  const SINCE = new Date('2026-10-05T02:00:00.000Z');
  const NOW_MS = Date.parse('2026-10-07T02:00:00.000Z');
  const OPTIONS = { since: SINCE, deadline: NOW_MS + 120_000 };

  type RefundStub = { id: string; payment_intent: string | { id: string } | null };

  function makeDeps(refunds: RefundStub[], now: () => Date = () => new Date(NOW_MS)) {
    const list = jest.fn(() => ({
      async *[Symbol.asyncIterator]() {
        for (const refund of refunds) yield refund;
      },
    }));
    const deps = { store: { name: 'store' }, stripe: { refunds: { list } }, now } as unknown as RefundServiceDeps;
    return { deps, list };
  }

  /** 取り込みの答え。results の中身は数えるだけなので空の物でよい */
  const synced = (count = 1) => ({
    kind: 'synced',
    orderId: 'order-1',
    orderStatus: 'paid',
    results: Array.from({ length: count }, () => ({})),
  });

  beforeEach(() => {
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds.mockReset();
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds.mockResolvedValue(synced());
    mockListPendingRefundPaymentIntents.mockReset();
    mockListPendingRefundPaymentIntents.mockResolvedValue([]);
  });

  it('保留の返金の支払いを先に、Stripe の返金の一覧（作った日時で絞る）の支払いを後に集め、重複なしに1つずつ取り込む', async () => {
    const { deps, list } = makeDeps([
      { id: 're_1', payment_intent: 'pi_a' },
      { id: 're_2', payment_intent: 'pi_b' },
      { id: 're_3', payment_intent: 'pi_a' },
      { id: 're_4', payment_intent: { id: 'pi_c' } },
      { id: 're_5', payment_intent: null },
    ]);
    mockListPendingRefundPaymentIntents.mockResolvedValue(['pi_b', 'pi_d']);

    const report = await reconcileRecentRefunds(deps, OPTIONS);

    expect(list).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ created: { gte: Math.floor(SINCE.getTime() / 1000) }, limit: 100 });
    expect(mockListPendingRefundPaymentIntents).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps.store, 500);
    // 保留の側（pi_b・pi_d）が先。時間切れで止まる時に、保留の側を後回しにしない
    expect(mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds.mock.calls.map(([, paymentIntentId]) => paymentIntentId)).toEqual([
      'pi_b',
      'pi_d',
      'pi_a',
      'pi_c',
    ]);
    expect(mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps, 'pi_a');
    expect(report).toEqual({ checkedPaymentIntents: 4, syncedRefunds: 4, errors: [] });
  });

  it('Stripe の一覧が空でも、保留の返金の支払いは取り込む', async () => {
    const { deps } = makeDeps([]);
    mockListPendingRefundPaymentIntents.mockResolvedValue(['pi_pending']);

    const report = await reconcileRecentRefunds(deps, OPTIONS);

    expect(mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds).toHaveBeenCalledWith(deps, 'pi_pending');
    expect(report.checkedPaymentIntents).toBe(1);
  });

  it('syncedRefunds は書いた返金の数。入金が決まる前の注文の支払い（skipped_unpaid）は数えない', async () => {
    const { deps } = makeDeps([
      { id: 're_1', payment_intent: 'pi_a' },
      { id: 're_2', payment_intent: 'pi_b' },
    ]);
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(synced(2))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ kind: 'skipped_unpaid', orderId: 'order-2', orderStatus: 'pending' });

    const report = await reconcileRecentRefunds(deps, OPTIONS);

    expect(report).toEqual({ checkedPaymentIntents: 2, syncedRefunds: 2, errors: [] });
  });

  it('注文の無い支払いは数えるだけで、失敗にしない', async () => {
    const { deps } = makeDeps([
      { id: 're_1', payment_intent: 'pi_orphan' },
      { id: 're_2', payment_intent: 'pi_b' },
    ]);
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError())
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(synced());

    const report = await reconcileRecentRefunds(deps, OPTIONS);

    expect(report).toEqual({ checkedPaymentIntents: 2, syncedRefunds: 1, errors: [] });
  });

  it('1つの失敗で全体を止めない。失敗は支払いの番号と原因の記号だけを残す（例外の文は残さない）', async () => {
    const { deps } = makeDeps([
      { id: 're_1', payment_intent: 'pi_a' },
      { id: 're_2', payment_intent: 'pi_b' },
    ]);
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(Object.assign(new Error('Stripe is down for buyer@example.com'), { statusCode: 503 }))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(synced());

    const report = await reconcileRecentRefunds(deps, OPTIONS);

    expect(report).toEqual({
      checkedPaymentIntents: 2,
      syncedRefunds: 1,
      errors: [{ paymentIntentId: 'pi_a', message: 'stripe_unavailable' }],
    });
    expect(JSON.stringify(report)).not.toContain('buyer@example.com');
  });

  it('書いている間に返金が変わり続けて収まらない支払い（RefundSyncNotConvergedError）は、決済の照合と同じ記号 not_converged で残す', async () => {
    const { deps } = makeDeps([{ id: 're_1', payment_intent: 'pi_a' }]);
    mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds.mockRejectedValueOnce(new RefundSyncNotConvergedError());

    const report = await reconcileRecentRefunds(deps, OPTIONS);

    expect(report).toEqual({
      checkedPaymentIntents: 1,
      syncedRefunds: 0,
      errors: [{ paymentIntentId: 'pi_a', message: 'not_converged' }],
    });
  });

  it('時間切れ: deadline に届いたら、残りを次の夜に回す', async () => {
    const clock = [new Date(NOW_MS), new Date(OPTIONS.deadline)];
    const { deps } = makeDeps(
      [
        { id: 're_1', payment_intent: 'pi_a' },
        { id: 're_2', payment_intent: 'pi_b' },
      ],
      () => clock.shift() ?? new Date(OPTIONS.deadline),
    );
    const warn = jest.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => undefined);

    try {
      const report = await reconcileRecentRefunds(deps, OPTIONS);

      expect(report).toEqual({ checkedPaymentIntents: 1, syncedRefunds: 1, errors: [] });
      expect(mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(warn).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    } finally {
      warn.mockRestore();
    }
  });

  it('Stripe の返金の一覧を読めなければ、そのまま投げる（窓口が受け止めて、失敗として errors に残す）', async () => {
    const failure = Object.assign(new Error('connection reset'), { type: 'StripeConnectionError' });
    const deps = {
      store: { name: 'store' },
      stripe: {
        refunds: {
          list: () => ({
            [Symbol.asyncIterator]: () => ({
              next: async () => {
                throw failure;
              },
            }),
          }),
        },
      },
      now: () => new Date(NOW_MS),
    } as unknown as RefundServiceDeps;

    await expect(reconcileRecentRefunds(deps, OPTIONS)).rejects.toBe(failure);
    expect(mockSyncPaymentIntentRefunds).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

describe('reconcileStripePayouts', () => {
  it('syncs recent payouts and counts mismatches', async () => {
    const stripe = {
      payouts: {
        list: () => [
          { id: 'po_matched' },
          { id: 'po_mismatch' },
        ],
      },
    };
    const syncPayout = jest.fn(async (payoutId: string) => ({
      reconciliationStatus: payoutId === 'po_mismatch' ? 'mismatch' : 'matched',
    }));

    const report = await reconcileStripePayouts({ stripe, syncPayout });

    expect(syncPayout).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(report.syncedPayouts).toBe(2);
    expect(report.payoutMismatches).toBe(1);
    expect(report.errors).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('records a payout failure and continues', async () => {
    const stripe = { payouts: { list: () => [{ id: 'po_1' }, { id: 'po_2' }] } };
    const syncPayout = jest
      .fn()
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('payout sync failed'))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ reconciliationStatus: 'matched' });

    const report = await reconcileStripePayouts({ stripe, syncPayout });

    expect(report.syncedPayouts).toBe(1);
    expect(report.errors).toEqual([{ sourceId: 'po_1', reason: 'unexpected_error' }]);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 10: 毎晩の照合を直す**

`src/lib/stripe/reconcile-orders.ts` の 1〜110 行目（先頭から `reconcileStripeOrders` の閉じ括弧まで）を、次に置き換える。112 行目からの出金の照合（`PayoutSnapshot` 以降）は変えない。

```ts
import type { RefundServiceDeps } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-service';
import { listPendingRefundPaymentIntents } from '@/lib/orders/refund/refund-store';
import { OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError, RefundSyncNotConvergedError, syncPaymentIntentRefunds } from './order-refund-sync';
import { ReconcileTransientError } from './checkout-payment-reader';
import { webhookFailureCause, type WebhookFailureCause } from './webhook-events';

type OrderState = { payment_intent_id: string };
type ReconcileDatabase = {
  from(table: 'orders'): {
    select(columns: string): Promise<{ data: OrderState[] | null; error: { message?: string } | null }>;
  };
};
type PaymentIntentSnapshot = { id: string; status: string; amount: number; currency: string; created: number };
/** 注文の無い支払いが全額返金済みかを決めるのに要る分だけ */
type RefundSnapshot = { status: string | null; amount: number };
type ReconcileStripe = {
  paymentIntents: { list(params: { limit: number }): AsyncIterable<PaymentIntentSnapshot> | Iterable<PaymentIntentSnapshot> };
  refunds: { list(params: { payment_intent: string; limit: number }): AsyncIterable<RefundSnapshot> | Iterable<RefundSnapshot> };
};

/** 照合の1件ずつの失敗。原因の記号だけを残す（設計書 2026-10-05 グループ B の 3-3・4-5） */
export type StripeReconciliationError = { sourceId: string; reason: WebhookFailureCause };

/** 注文の無い成功の支払いのうち、直近7日に作られたもの。毎晩の店への知らせに載せる（設計書 2026-10-05 グループ B の 6） */
export type UnmatchedRecentPayment = { id: string; amount: number; currency: string; created: number };

/** 注文の無い支払いを「直近」と数える期間 */
const RECENT_PAYMENT_SECONDS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60;

export type StripeOrderReconciliationReport = {
  checkedPayments: number;
  unmatchedActivePayments: string[];
  unmatchedRecentPayments: UnmatchedRecentPayment[];
  syncedBalanceTransactions: number;
  errors: StripeReconciliationError[];
};

function failureOf(sourceId: string, error: unknown): StripeReconciliationError {
  return { sourceId, reason: webhookFailureCause(error) };
}

/** 成功した返金の額の合計。ページを全部たどる */
async function succeededRefundTotal(stripe: ReconcileStripe, paymentIntentId: string): Promise<number> {
  let total = 0;
  for await (const refund of stripe.refunds.list({ payment_intent: paymentIntentId, limit: 100 })) {
    if (refund.status === 'succeeded') total += Math.max(0, refund.amount);
  }
  return total;
}

export async function reconcileStripeOrders({
  database,
  stripe,
  syncAccounting,
  now = () => new Date(),
}: {
  database: ReconcileDatabase;
  stripe: ReconcileStripe;
  syncAccounting?: (paymentIntentId: string) => Promise<unknown>;
  now?: () => Date;
}): Promise<StripeOrderReconciliationReport> {
  const { data: orders, error } = await database.from('orders').select('payment_intent_id');
  if (error) throw new ReconcileTransientError('db_unavailable');
  const paymentIntentIdsWithOrder = new Set((orders ?? []).map((order) => order.payment_intent_id));
  const recentSince = Math.floor(now().getTime() / 1000) - RECENT_PAYMENT_SECONDS;
  const report: StripeOrderReconciliationReport = {
    checkedPayments: 0,
    unmatchedActivePayments: [],
    unmatchedRecentPayments: [],
    syncedBalanceTransactions: 0,
    errors: [],
  };

  for await (const payment of stripe.paymentIntents.list({ limit: 100 })) {
    if (payment.status !== 'succeeded') continue;
    report.checkedPayments += 1;

    // 注文の無い支払いだけ、返金し切っているかを読む。注文のある支払いの返金は、返金の照合（reconcileRecentRefunds）が合わせる。
    // 支払いごとに失敗を受け止め、その回の残りを止めない（設計書 4-5）
    if (!paymentIntentIdsWithOrder.has(payment.id)) {
      try {
        if ((await succeededRefundTotal(stripe, payment.id)) < payment.amount) {
          report.unmatchedActivePayments.push(payment.id);
          if (payment.created >= recentSince) {
            report.unmatchedRecentPayments.push({
              id: payment.id,
              amount: payment.amount,
              currency: payment.currency,
              created: payment.created,
            });
          }
        }
      } catch (refundError) {
        report.errors.push(failureOf(payment.id, refundError));
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (!syncAccounting) continue;
    try {
      await syncAccounting(payment.id);
      report.syncedBalanceTransactions += 1;
    } catch (accountingError) {
      report.errors.push(failureOf(payment.id, accountingError));
    }
  }
  return report;
}

/** 毎晩の返金の照合の結果。errors[].message は原因の記号（収まらない失敗は 'not_converged'、ほかは webhookFailureCause の記号。例外の文は入れない。個人情報が混ざりうるため） */
export type RecentRefundReconciliationReport = {
  checkedPaymentIntents: number;
  syncedRefunds: number;
  errors: Array<{ paymentIntentId: string; message: string }>;
};

/** こちらの保留の返金の支払いを読む件数の上限（DB の関数 list_pending_refund_payment_intents の上限） */
const PENDING_REFUND_PAYMENT_INTENT_LIMIT = 500;

function paymentIntentIdOf(value: string | { id: string } | null): string | null {
  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : (value?.id ?? null);
}

/**
 * 毎晩の返金の照合（グループ E-2 設計書 6-2）。こちらの保留の返金の支払いを先に、前の48時間に Stripe で作られた返金の支払いを後に
 * 集め（重複なし）、1つずつ取り込み（order-refund-sync.ts）に通す。知らせの取りこぼしと、保留から成功・失敗に変わる返金を拾う。
 * 注文の無い支払いは数えるだけ、1つの失敗で全体を止めない。deadline（ミリ秒）に届いたら、残りを次の夜に回す。
 * 後回しになるのは、次の夜も範囲が重なる48時間の側にする（保留の側は、この照合でしか拾わない）。
 */
export async function reconcileRecentRefunds(
  deps: RefundServiceDeps,
  options: { since: Date; deadline: number },
): Promise<RecentRefundReconciliationReport> {
  const paymentIntentIds = new Set<string>(
    await listPendingRefundPaymentIntents(deps.store, PENDING_REFUND_PAYMENT_INTENT_LIMIT),
  );
  for await (const refund of deps.stripe.refunds.list({
    created: { gte: Math.floor(options.since.getTime() / 1000) },
    limit: 100,
  })) {
    const paymentIntentId = paymentIntentIdOf(refund.payment_intent);
    if (paymentIntentId) paymentIntentIds.add(paymentIntentId);
  }

  const report: RecentRefundReconciliationReport = { checkedPaymentIntents: 0, syncedRefunds: 0, errors: [] };
  for (const paymentIntentId of paymentIntentIds) {
    if (deps.now().getTime() >= options.deadline) {
      console.warn('[refund-reconcile] stopped at the deadline; the rest waits for the next run');
      break;
    }

    report.checkedPaymentIntents += 1;
    try {
      const synced = await syncPaymentIntentRefunds(deps, paymentIntentId);
      if (synced.kind === 'synced') report.syncedRefunds += synced.results.length;
    } catch (error) {
      // 注文の無い支払い（注文を作れなかった支払い）は、知らせの受け口が要対応にしている。ここでは数えるだけ
      if (error instanceof OrderNotFoundForPaymentIntentError) continue;
      report.errors.push({
        paymentIntentId,
        // 読み直せば収まる失敗。決済の照合（toReconcileError）と同じ記号にする
        message: error instanceof RefundSyncNotConvergedError ? 'not_converged' : webhookFailureCause(error),
      });
    }
  }
  return report;
}
```

```ts
  describe('返金の照合（グループ E-2 設計書 6-2）', () => {

        since: new Date(NOW - 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000),

      await POST(authorizedRequest());

      expect(mockReconcileRefunds.mock.invocationCallOrder[0]).toBeLessThan(mockReconcileOrders.mock.invocationCallOrder[0]);
      expect(mockReconcileOrders.mock.invocationCallOrder[0]).toBeLessThan(mockReconcilePayouts.mock.invocationCallOrder[0]);
    });

        Object.assign(new Error('Stripe is down for buyer@example.com'), { code: 'db_unavailable' }),
      );
      const error = jest.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});

      try {
        const response = await POST(authorizedRequest());
        const body = await response.json();

        expect(response.status).toBe(200);
        expect(body.data.errors).toEqual([{ sourceId: 'refunds', reason: 'db_unavailable' }]);
        expect(body.data.syncedRefunds).toBe(0);
        expect(mockReconcileOrders).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        expect(mockReconcilePayouts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        expect(mockRecordHeartbeat).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockDatabase, 'stripe_reconcile', true, null);
        expect(error).toHaveBeenCalledWith('[stripe-reconcile] Refund reconciliation failed', 'db_unavailable');
        // 例外の文（個人情報が混ざりうる）は、答えにもログにも出さない
        expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.toContain('buyer@example.com');
        expect(JSON.stringify(error.mock.calls)).not.toContain('buyer@example.com');
      } finally {
        error.mockRestore();
      }
    });
  });

  describe('見つかったことのメール（1回の実行につき1通）', () => {
    const unmatched = [
      { id: 'pi_1', amount: 89000, currency: 'jpy', created: 1_790_000_000 },
      { id: 'pi_2', amount: 1200, currency: 'jpy', created: 1_790_000_100 },
    ];
    const orderErrors = [{ sourceId: 'pi_9', reason: 'stripe_unavailable' }];
    const refundErrors = [{ paymentIntentId: 'pi_8', message: 'db_unavailable' }];
    const refundErrorsAsReported = [{ sourceId: 'pi_8', reason: 'db_unavailable' }];
    const payoutErrors = [{ sourceId: 'po_1', reason: 'db_unavailable' }];

    it('直近7日の注文の無い支払いがあれば、1通送り、監査にその支払いの ID を残す', async () => {
      mockReconcileOrders.mockResolvedValue(orderReport({
        checkedPayments: 2,
        unmatchedActivePayments: ['pi_1', 'pi_2'],
        unmatchedRecentPayments: unmatched,
      }));
      mockReconcilePayouts.mockResolvedValue(payoutReport());

      const response = await POST(authorizedRequest());

      expect(response.status).toBe(200);
      expect(mockReconcileFindingsMail).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ unmatched, errors: [] });
      expect(mockSendOpsAlertMail).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(mockSendOpsAlertMail).toHaveBeenCalledWith(findingsMail);
      expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
        metadata: expect.objectContaining({ unmatchedRecentPaymentIds: ['pi_1', 'pi_2'] }),
      }));
    });

    it('失敗だけのときも、支払いの失敗・返金の失敗・入金の失敗をまとめて1通送る', async () => {
      mockReconcileOrders.mockResolvedValue(orderReport({ errors: orderErrors }));
      mockReconcileRefunds.mockResolvedValue(refundReport({ errors: refundErrors }));
      mockReconcilePayouts.mockResolvedValue(payoutReport({ errors: payoutErrors }));

      await POST(authorizedRequest());

      expect(mockReconcileFindingsMail).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        unmatched: [],
        errors: [...orderErrors, ...refundErrorsAsReported, ...payoutErrors],
      });
      expect(mockSendOpsAlertMail).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

    it('支払いと失敗の両方があっても1通だけ送る', async () => {
      mockReconcileOrders.mockResolvedValue(orderReport({ unmatchedRecentPayments: unmatched, errors: orderErrors }));
      mockReconcilePayouts.mockResolvedValue(payoutReport({ errors: payoutErrors }));

      await POST(authorizedRequest());

      expect(mockSendOpsAlertMail).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(mockReconcileFindingsMail).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ unmatched, errors: [...orderErrors, ...payoutErrors] });
    });

    it('直近7日の支払いも失敗も無ければ送らない（7日より古い注文の無い支払いだけのときも）', async () => {
      mockReconcileOrders.mockResolvedValue(orderReport({ checkedPayments: 1, unmatchedActivePayments: ['pi_old'] }));
      mockReconcilePayouts.mockResolvedValue(payoutReport());

      const response = await POST(authorizedRequest());

      expect(response.status).toBe(200);
      expect(mockReconcileFindingsMail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(mockSendOpsAlertMail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
        metadata: expect.objectContaining({ unmatchedRecentPaymentIds: [] }),
      }));
    });

    it('監査の行と成功の記録のあとに送る', async () => {
      mockReconcileOrders.mockResolvedValue(orderReport({ unmatchedRecentPayments: unmatched }));
      mockReconcilePayouts.mockResolvedValue(payoutReport());

      await POST(authorizedRequest());

      const audit = mockLogAudit.mock.invocationCallOrder[0];
      const heartbeat = mockRecordHeartbeat.mock.invocationCallOrder[0];
      const mail = mockSendOpsAlertMail.mock.invocationCallOrder[0];
      expect(audit).toBeLessThan(heartbeat);
      expect(heartbeat).toBeLessThan(mail);
    });

    it.each([
      ['false を返しても', () => mockSendOpsAlertMail.mockResolvedValue(false)],
      ['例外になっても', () => mockSendOpsAlertMail.mockRejectedValue(new Error('smtp down'))],
    ])('メールの送信が%s、応答は200のままで、成功の記録は1回だけ', async (_name, arrange) => {
      arrange();
      mockReconcileOrders.mockResolvedValue(orderReport({ unmatchedRecentPayments: unmatched }));
      mockReconcilePayouts.mockResolvedValue(payoutReport());
      const error = jest.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});

      const response = await POST(authorizedRequest());

      expect(mockSendOpsAlertMail).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(response.status).toBe(200);
      expect(mockRecordHeartbeat).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(mockRecordHeartbeat).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockDatabase, 'stripe_reconcile', true, null);
      error.mockRestore();
    });

    it('監査に残す支払いの ID は20件まで（金額などは残さない）', async () => {
      const many = Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, i) => ({ id: `pi_${i + 1}`, amount: 1000, currency: 'jpy', created: 1_790_000_000 }));
      mockReconcileOrders.mockResolvedValue(orderReport({ unmatchedRecentPayments: many }));
      mockReconcilePayouts.mockResolvedValue(payoutReport());

      await POST(authorizedRequest());

      expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
        metadata: expect.objectContaining({ unmatchedRecentPaymentIds: many.slice(0, 20).map((payment) => payment.id) }),
      }));
      expect(JSON.stringify(mockLogAudit.mock.calls)).not.toContain('"amount"');
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
    mockSweepAwaitingRefunds.mockResolvedValue({ checked: 5, synced: 3, errored: 1, failures: 1, timeBudgetExhausted: false });

    const response = await sweep();

    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({ checkedRefunds: 5, syncedRefunds: 3, erroredRefunds: 1, failed: 1 });
    expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      outcome: 'error',
      metadata: expect.objectContaining({ checkedRefunds: 5, syncedRefunds: 3, erroredRefunds: 1 }),
    }));
  });

  it('返金の見回りが時間切れを報告したら、要約の timeBudgetExhausted に反映する', async () => {
    mockSweepAwaitingRefunds.mockResolvedValue({ checked: 2, synced: 2, errored: 0, failures: 0, timeBudgetExhausted: true });

    const response = await sweep();

    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({ timeBudgetExhausted: true });
    expect(mockLogAudit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ outcome: 'failure' }));
  });

  it('拾い上げで時間を使い切っていたら、返金の見回りは動かさない', async () => {
    mockRecoverOrphanPayments.mockResolvedValue({ checkedSessions: 0, recovered: [], failed: 0, timeBudgetExhausted: true });

    const response = await sweep();

    expect(mockSweepAwaitingRefunds).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({ timeBudgetExhausted: true, checkedRefunds: 0 });
  });

  it('返金の見回りが失敗しても見回りは最後まで進み、失敗の数に入れる', async () => {
    mockSweepAwaitingRefunds.mockRejectedValue(Object.assign(new Error('x'), { type: 'StripeConnectionError' }));
    const error = jest.spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});

    const response = await sweep();

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({ failed: 1, checkedRefunds: 0 });
    expect(error).toHaveBeenCalledWith('[cron] failed to sweep awaiting refunds', 'stripe_unavailable');
    expect(mockRecordHeartbeat).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockServiceClient, 'order_sweep', true, null);
    error.mockRestore();
  });

  it('返金の見回りは、拾い上げの後・最後の成功の記録の前に動く', async () => {
    await sweep();

    const recovery = mockRecoverOrphanPayments.mock.invocationCallOrder[0];
    const refunds = mockSweepAwaitingRefunds.mock.invocationCallOrder[0];
    const heartbeat = mockRecordHeartbeat.mock.invocationCallOrder[0];
    expect(recovery).toBeLessThan(refunds);
    expect(refunds).toBeLessThan(heartbeat);
  });
```

```ts
  // 今の45秒の予算の残りで行い、読み切れない分は次の回に回す

        olderThan: new Date(nowMs - AWAITING_REFUND_MIN_AGE_MS),
        limit: MAX_AWAITING_REFUNDS_PER_RUN,
        deadline: startedAt + TIME_BUDGET_MS,
      });
      failed += awaitingRefunds.failures;
      timeBudgetExhausted = awaitingRefunds.timeBudgetExhausted;
    } catch (refundSweepError) {
      console.error('[cron] failed to sweep awaiting refunds', webhookFailureCause(refundSweepError));
      failed += 1;
    }
  }

  // 最後の成功は、遅くなりうる後続（要約の読み込み・メール・監査の行）の前に記録する。
```

```ts
import Stripe from 'stripe';

const getStripe = getStripeServerClient as jest.MockedFunction<typeof getStripeServerClient>;
const syncRefunds = syncPaymentIntentRefunds as jest.MockedFunction<typeof syncPaymentIntentRefunds>;

const ORDER_ID = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';

/** 取り込みの答え。返金の記録を1件書いて、注文がその状態になった */
function syncedWith(orderStatus: 'paid' | 'cancelled', refundedAmount: number) {
  return {
    kind: 'synced' as const,
    orderId: ORDER_ID,
    orderStatus,
    results: [
      {
        refundId: '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222',
        orderId: ORDER_ID,
        status: 'succeeded' as const,
        newlyAccepted: true,
        newlyFailed: false,
        orderStatus,
        refundedAmount,
        rereserveShortage: 0,
        emailEnqueued: false,
        exceptionId: null,
      },
    ],
  };
}

describe('POST /api/admin/orders/[id]/refund', () => {

      select: () => ({ eq: () => ({ maybeSingle }) }),

    createSupabase.mockResolvedValue({ from } as never);
    const refundCreate = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({
      id: 're_konbini',
      amount: 21_499,
      currency: 'jpy',
      reason: 'requested_by_customer',
      status: 'requires_action',
    });
    getStripe.mockReturnValue({ refunds: { create: refundCreate } } as never);
    syncRefunds.mockResolvedValue({ kind: 'synced', orderId: ORDER_ID, orderStatus: 'paid', results: [] });

    const response = await POST(
      new Request(`http://localhost/api/admin/orders/${ORDER_ID}/refund`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },

      }),

    const body = await response.json();

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(syncRefunds).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockRefundDeps, 'pi_konbini');
    expect(body.orderStatus).toBe('paid');
    expect(body.refundStatus).toBe('requires_action');
  });

  it('allows a shipped order to be refunded without changing it locally', async () => {
    authorize.mockResolvedValue({
      ok: true,
      userId: 'admin-1',
      role: 'admin',

    });
    const maybeSingle = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({

        create: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({
          id: 're_shipped',
          amount: 21_499,
          currency: 'jpy',
          reason: 'requested_by_customer',
          status: 'succeeded',
        }),
      },
    } as never);
    syncRefunds.mockResolvedValue(syncedWith('cancelled', 21_499));

    const response = await POST(

        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ reason: 'requested_by_customer' }),
      }),
      { params: Promise.resolve({ id: ORDER_ID }) },
    );

    expect(response.status).toBe(200);
    expect(syncRefunds).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockRefundDeps, 'pi_shipped');
  });

  it('does not expose Stripe error details to the client', async () => {
    authorize.mockResolvedValue({
      ok: true,
      userId: 'admin-1',
      role: 'admin',
      actorEmail: 'admin@example.com',
    });
    const maybeSingle = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({
      data: {
        id: ORDER_ID,
        payment_intent_id: 'pi_sensitive_identifier',
        status: 'paid',
        total_amount: 21_499,
      },
      error: null,
    });
    createSupabase.mockResolvedValue({
      from: jest.fn().mockReturnValue({ select: () => ({ eq: () => ({ maybeSingle }) }) }),
    } as never);
    getStripe.mockReturnValue({
      refunds: {
        create: jest.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Stripe.errors.StripeInvalidRequestError({
          type: 'invalid_request_error',
          message: 'No such PaymentIntent: pi_sensitive_identifier',
          statusCode: 400,
        })),
      },
    } as never);

    const response = await POST(
      new Request(`http://localhost/api/admin/orders/${ORDER_ID}/refund`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ reason: 'requested_by_customer' }),
      }),
      { params: Promise.resolve({ id: ORDER_ID }) },
    );
    const body = await response.json();

    expect(response.status).toBe(400);
    expect(body).toEqual({ error: 'Stripe返金処理に失敗しました。' });
    expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.toContain('pi_sensitive_identifier');
  });
});
```

```ts
    mockStripeRefundsOf.mockImplementation(() => (amountRefunded > 0 ? [stripeRefund] : []));
    const refund = {
      store: client,
      stripe: {},
      now: () => new Date(),
      notifyShopOfRefundFailure: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(true),
      scheduleOrderEmailDelivery: jest.fn(),
    } as unknown as Parameters<typeof createReconcilerRefundSync>[0];
```

そして同じ関数の最後の返り値の中、199 行目（前）:

```ts
      syncRefunds: createReconcilerRefundSync(client as unknown as OrderRefundDatabase, stripeRefunds),
```

（後）:

